lemmas.def_en: an Australian boomerang; one side flat and the other convex

examples.en: Kiley carefully unpacked her art supplies and set up her easel by the window.
examples.zh: 基莉小心翼翼地打开画具，在窗边架起了画架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kiley 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 朋友, 邻居, 亲属
lemmas.def_en: your friends and acquaintances

examples.en: She invited all her kith and kin to celebrate her thirtieth birthday together.
examples.zh: 她邀请了所有的亲朋好友一起来庆祝她的三十岁生日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (常伴有文娱节目的)夏威夷式宴会,[烹调]卢奥(用嫩芋叶和章鱼或鸡加椰子酱烹制成的一种菜)
lemmas.def_en: an elaborate Hawaiian feast or party (especially one accompanied by traditional foods and entertainment)

examples.en: The hotel hosted a traditional beachside luau featuring roast pork and fire dancers.
examples.zh: 酒店举办了一场传统的海滩夏威夷宴会，提供烤猪肉和火舞表演。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luau 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 闪光饰品, 珠片织物
lemmas.def_en: adornment consisting of a small piece of shiny material used to decorate clothing

examples.en: She wore an elegant black evening gown adorned with sparkling diamante trim.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件饰有闪亮珠片饰边的优雅黑色晚礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diamante 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bold outlaw (especially on the American frontier)

examples.en: The sheriff pursued the dangerous desperado across the dry desert for three weeks.
examples.zh: 警长在干燥的沙漠中追捕那个危险的亡命之徒长达三周。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 desperado 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 晒黑的, 有晒斑的, 日炙的
lemmas.def_en: suffering from overexposure to direct sunlight

examples.en: He forgot his protective lotion and ended up with painful, brightly sunburnt shoulders.
examples.zh: 他忘了涂防晒乳液，结果双肩被晒得通红发痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunburnt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a telephone with a microphone and loudspeaker; can be used without picking up a handset; several people can participate in a call at the same time

examples.en: He put his mother on speakerphone so everyone could hear her news.
examples.zh: 他把母亲的电话调成了免提，以便大家都能听到她的消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 speakerphone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敏捷, 轻快, 乐意
lemmas.def_en: liveliness and eagerness

examples.en: The eager young assistant accepted the unexpected assignment with surprising alacrity.
examples.zh: 这位热切的年轻助手以惊人的乐意态度接受了这项意外任务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alacrity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds

examples.en: The museum displays an eighteenth-century pianoforte once played by famous composers.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一架曾由著名作曲家演奏过的18世纪钢琴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pianoforte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可废止的, 可取消的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being revoked or annulled

examples.en: He established a revocable trust that could be altered at any time.
examples.zh: 他设立了一个可以随时修改的可撤销信托。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 revocable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 酒渣鼻, 红斑痤疮
lemmas.def_en: a skin disease of adults (more often women) in which blood vessels of the face enlarge resulting in a flushed appearance

examples.en: Sun exposure often worsens the redness on her cheeks caused by rosacea.
examples.zh: 日晒常常加剧她脸上由酒渣鼻引起的红斑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rosacea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 情夫, 情妇, 情人
lemmas.def_en: a woman's lover

examples.en: The secret letters revealed that the diplomat was meeting his wealthy paramour.
examples.zh: 那些密信揭露了这位外交官正与其富有情人幽会的事实。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paramour 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sexual attraction to children

examples.en: The government introduced strict new legislation to combat online paedophilia and exploitation.
examples.zh: 政府出台了严格的新法律来打击网络恋童癖和剥削行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paedophilia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unduly excited

examples.en: The overexcited puppy dashed around the living room, knocking over a lamp.
examples.zh: 那只过度兴奋的小狗在客厅里乱冲乱撞，撞倒了一盏灯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overexcited 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: conveyed by sea

examples.en: The island nation relies heavily on seaborne trade for its energy supplies.
examples.zh: 这个岛国的能源供应高度依赖海上贸易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seaborne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small round piece of linen placed under a dish or bowl

examples.en: Grandmother placed a delicate lace doily under the antique porcelain vase.
examples.zh: 祖母在古董瓷瓶下垫了一块精致的蕾丝小桌巾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doily 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the shore of a sea or ocean

examples.en: Rugged cliffs and sandy beaches alternate along this dramatic northern seacoast.
examples.zh: 崎岖的悬崖与沙滩在这片壮丽的北部海岸沿线交替出现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seacoast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various seaweeds that grow underwater in shallow beds

examples.en: Healthy seagrass beds provide essential shelter and food for diverse marine life.
examples.zh: 健康的海草床为各种海洋生物提供了至关重要的庇护所和食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seagrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short amusing opera

examples.en: The theater company staged a lively performance of a classic Viennese operetta.
examples.zh: 剧团生动地上演了一部经典的维也纳轻歌剧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 operetta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 中止, 暂搁, 停止, 归属待定
lemmas.def_en: temporary cessation or suspension

examples.en: The construction project was held in abeyance pending final regulatory approval.
examples.zh: 在等待最终监管批准期间，该建设项目被暂时搁置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abeyance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a religious orientation of doubt; a denial of ultimate knowledge of the existence of God

examples.en: His intellectual journey led him from strict religious dogma to thoughtful agnosticism.
examples.zh: 他的思想历程引领他从严格的宗教教条走向深思熟虑的不可知论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agnosticism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having dissimilar alleles at corresponding chromosomal loci

examples.en: The genetic test confirmed that she is heterozygous for the rare mutation.
examples.zh: 基因检测证实她是该罕见突变的杂合子。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 杂合性, 异型接合性
lemmas.def_en: the state of being heterozygous; having two different alleles of the same gene

examples.en: High genetic heterozygosity helps the population adapt better to changing environmental conditions.
examples.zh: 较高的基因杂合度有助于该种群更好地适应不断变化的环境条件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heterozygous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 事情, 工作, 陋屋, 住所
lemmas.def_en: an entire system; used in the phrase `the whole shebang'

examples.en: Tired of the chaos, he packed his bags and sold the whole shebang.
examples.zh: 厌倦了这种混乱，他收拾行囊，把整套家当全卖了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shebang 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rich Middle Eastern cake made of thin layers of flaky pastry filled with nuts and honey

examples.en: We enjoyed sweet baklava with layers of nuts and honey for dessert.
examples.zh: 我们享用了夹着坚果和蜂蜜的香甜果仁蜜饼作为甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baklava 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 沉着, 泰然自若, 垂直
lemmas.def_en: great coolness and composure under strain

examples.en: The experienced diplomat handled the aggressive interview questions with remarkable aplomb.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官以极大的沉着应对了那些咄咄逼人的采访提问。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aplomb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: anaerobic bacterium producing botulin the toxin that causes botulism

examples.en: Improperly canned food carries a serious risk of developing deadly botulinum toxin.
examples.zh: 罐头食品若封装不当，会有滋生致命肉毒杆菌毒素的严重风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 botulinum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a formal written defense of something you believe in strongly

examples.en: The retired politician published a lengthy apologia defending his controversial economic decisions.
examples.zh: 这位退休政客发表了一篇长篇辩白书，为其备受争议的经济决策辩护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apologia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: decorative cover for a bed

examples.en: She smoothed out the colorful quilted bedspread before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 在客人到达之前，她抚平了五彩斑斓的绗缝床罩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedspread 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an elevated box for viewing events at a sports stadium

examples.en: The company executives watched the football match from a private luxury skybox.
examples.zh: 公司高管们在私人豪华贵宾包厢里观看了这场足球比赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skybox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the brain and the blood vessels that supply it

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise can significantly reduce the risk of acute cerebrovascular disease in elderly patients.
examples.zh: 定期进行有氧运动可以显著降低老年患者患急性脑血管疾病的风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cerebrovascular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a canton

examples.en: Swiss voters rejected the proposed tax reform during the last cantonal referendum held in May.
examples.zh: 瑞士选民在五月举行的上一次州级公投中否决了拟议的税制改革。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantonal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or containing bitumen

examples.en: Heavy machinery began paving the highway with dense bituminous asphalt early this morning.
examples.zh: 重型机械今天清晨开始用密实的沥青材料铺设这条公路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bituminous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage; with two seats and a folding hood

examples.en: They enjoyed cruising along the scenic coastal highway in a vintage convertible cabriolet.
examples.zh: 他们开着一辆复古敞篷轿车，惬意地行驶在风景秀丽的沿海公路上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cabriolet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is the first to think of or make something

examples.en: The royal artificer crafted intricate mechanical clocks for the monarch's grand palace chambers.
examples.zh: 皇家技工为君主宏伟的宫殿内室制作了构造复杂的机械钟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 artificer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 石弹, 弹石弹游戏, 射石弹者站立的基线
lemmas.def_en: the 23rd letter of the Hebrew alphabet

examples.en: The young boy carefully aimed his lucky glass taw at the center marble ring.
examples.zh: 小男孩小心翼翼地用他心爱的主弹珠瞄准圆圈中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small brewery; consumption of the product is mainly elsewhere

examples.en: The trendy urban neighborhood now features an independent microbrewery serving seasonal craft beers.
examples.zh: 这个时髦的城市街区如今拥有一家供应季节性精酿啤酒的独立小啤酒厂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microbrewery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可交换的, 可兑换的, 可替换的
lemmas.def_en: suitable to be exchanged

examples.en: These gift certificates are easily exchangeable for cash at any participating store nationwide.
examples.zh: 这些礼券可在全国任何一家参与活动的门店内轻松兑换成现金。

lemmas.def_en: the quality of being capable of exchange or interchange

family_guide.root_logic: 以 exchangeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 游移不定, 踌躇, 犹豫, 摇摆
lemmas.def_en: be undecided about something; waver between conflicting positions or courses of action

examples.en: He continued to vacillate between accepting the high-paying corporate job and launching his startup.
examples.zh: 他一直在接受高薪企业职位和自主创业之间犹豫不决。

lemmas.def_zh: 游移不定, 踌躇, 不果断
lemmas.def_en: indecision in speech or action

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vacillate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 神职者的, 牧师的, 教会的
lemmas.def_en: of or associated with a church (especially a Christian Church)

examples.en: The distinguished ecclesiastic addressed the crowded cathedral regarding historic preservation and community outreach.
examples.zh: 这位尊贵的神职人员在拥挤的座堂向信众发表了关于历史保护和社区服务的讲话。

lemmas.def_zh: 神职人员, 牧师, 传教士
lemmas.def_en: a clergyman or other person in religious orders

examples.en: The distinguished ecclesiastic addressed the crowded cathedral regarding historic preservation and community outreach.
examples.zh: 这位尊贵的神职人员在拥挤的座堂向信众发表了关于历史保护和社区服务的讲话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ecclesiastic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun

examples.en: She applied moisturizing lotion each evening to maintain her radiant, golden holiday suntan.
examples.zh: 她每晚涂抹保湿乳液，以保持度假时晒出的光泽小麦肤色。

lemmas.def_en: (of skin) having a tan color from exposure to the sun

examples.en: a young bronzed Apollo

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suntan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 会缩的, 有收缩性的
lemmas.def_en: capable of contracting or being contracted

examples.en: Heart failure occurs when the contractile strength of the ventricular muscle fibers weakens severely.
examples.zh: 当心室肌纤维的收缩力严重减弱时，就会发生心力衰竭。

lemmas.def_zh: 收缩性, 缩小性, 伸缩力
lemmas.def_en: the capability or quality of shrinking or contracting, especially by muscle fibers and even some other forms of living matter

family_guide.root_logic: 以 contractile 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 戏弄的, 探询的, 古怪的
lemmas.def_en: playfully vexing (especially by ridicule); - Lawrence Durrell

examples.en: She raised one eyebrow and gave him a quizzical look after his bizarre explanation.
examples.zh: 听到他离奇的解释后，她挑起一边的眉毛，投以探询的目光。

lemmas.def_en: in a quizzical and questioning manner

examples.en: they looked quizzically at the doctor

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quizzical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: laugh quietly

examples.en: A few mischievous students began to snigger quietly at the back of the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 几名顽皮的学生在阶梯教室后排悄悄窃笑起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snigger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 堂吉诃德式的, 愚侠的, 狂热而侠义的, 理想而不实际的, 充满幻想的
lemmas.def_en: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic

examples.en: His quixotic quest to eliminate all forms of global bureaucracy quickly ended in failure.
examples.zh: 他试图消除全球所有形式官僚主义的不切实际追求很快便以失败告终。

lemmas.def_en: in a quixotic manner

examples.en: sent to jail for two years, he has quixotically refused to clear himself by betraying his colleagues

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quixotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one thousand tons

examples.en: The experimental weapon produced an explosive yield equal to fifty kilotons of conventional TNT.
examples.zh: 这种试验性武器产生的爆炸威力相当于五万吨传统梯恩梯当量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kiloton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: repeated regularly without thought or originality

examples.en: The romantic comedy was weighed down by a cliched plot and predictable dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部浪漫喜剧因陈腐老套的情节和缺乏悬念的台词而逊色不少。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cliched 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a late time of life

examples.en: The solemn old fortress carried dark whispered legends from days of ancient eld.
examples.zh: 这座庄严古老的堡垒流传着来自远古时代的低语暗黑传说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eld 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small space in a tissue or body part such as the area between veins on a leaf or an insect's wing

examples.en: The microscopic examination revealed a delicate vascular areola surrounding the newly formed tissue.
examples.zh: 显微镜检查显示新生组织周围环绕着精细的血管网隙结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 areola 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a large group of small songbirds that feed on insects taken on the wing

examples.en: A small brown flycatcher darted from the branch to snatch an unsuspecting insect midair.
examples.zh: 一只小褐鹟从树枝上猛冲而起，在半空中捕获了一只毫无防备的昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flycatcher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a fisheye lens

examples.en: The skateboard video was shot using a fisheye lens to create dramatic, exaggerated perspectives.
examples.zh: 这部滑板视频是用鱼眼镜头拍摄的，营造出了极具戏剧性的夸张视角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fisheye 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 福音派的教义, 福音主义
lemmas.def_en: stresses the importance of personal conversion and faith as the means of salvation

examples.en: The sociological study examined how modern evangelicalism has shaped conservative political movements in America.
examples.zh: 这项社会学研究探讨了现代福音主义是如何塑造美国保守派政治运动的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evangelicalism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卷头插画, 标题页, 主正面
lemmas.def_en: an ornamental facade

examples.en: The rare first edition features a detailed copperplate frontispiece depicting the author.
examples.zh: 这本珍贵的初版包含一幅描绘作者的精致铜版卷头插画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frontispiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having all sides or faces equal

examples.en: The architect incorporated an equilateral triangle into the central courtyard design.
examples.zh: 建筑师在中央庭院的设计中融入了一个等边三角形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equilateral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a training program in which a person is given information about physiological processes (heart rate or blood pressure) that is not normally available with the goal of gaining conscious control of them

examples.en: She used biofeedback techniques to manage her chronic migraines without heavy medication.
examples.zh: 她利用生物反馈技术控制慢性偏头痛，无需依赖大量药物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biofeedback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mental ability

examples.en: Solving this complex logistical puzzle will require all of our team's brainpower.
examples.zh: 解决这个复杂的后勤难题需要我们团队全部的脑力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brainpower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裤子；马裤（长及膝盖的裤子）
lemmas.def_en: informal term for breeches

examples.en: The little boy tore his britches while climbing over the wooden garden fence.
examples.zh: 小男孩在翻越花园木栅栏时把裤子撕破了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 britches 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sound made by beating a drum

examples.en: There is a steady drumbeat of public pressure urging the mayor to resign.
examples.zh: 公众施加了持续不断的呼声，敦促市长辞职。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drumbeat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rule for limiting or ending debate in a deliberative body

examples.en: Senate leaders filed for cloture to end the filibuster and force a final vote.
examples.zh: 参议院领袖申请终止辩论，以结束阻挠议事并强制进行最终表决。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cloture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by dark or relatively dark pigmentation of hair or skin or eyes

examples.en: He is a tall, handsome brunet man with deep and expressive brown eyes.
examples.zh: 他是一个身材高大、英俊深肤色黑发的男人，有一双深邃动人的棕色眼睛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brunet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a delicatessen that specializes in meats

examples.en: We ordered a gourmet charcuterie board featuring cured meats and local cheeses.
examples.zh: 我们点了一份精选熟食拼盘，里面有腌制肉类和当地奶酪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charcuterie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可爱的小宝贝, 亲亲
lemmas.def_en: a special loved one

examples.en: Don't worry about the mess, dearie; I will help you clean it up.
examples.zh: 别担心这团乱，亲爱的，我会帮你收拾干净的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dearie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the degree to which something is toxic to living cells

examples.en: The laboratory tested the new compound for cytotoxicity against several cancer cell lines.
examples.zh: 实验室检测了该新化合物对几种癌细胞系的细胞毒性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytotoxicity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tree of shrub of the genus Cornus often having showy bracts resembling flowers

examples.en: In early spring, the wild cornel tree bursts into delicate yellow blossoms.
examples.zh: 早春时节，野生山茱萸树绽放出娇嫩的黄色花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=coho salmon)银大马哈鱼(原产于太平洋海域)
lemmas.def_en: fatty pinkish flesh of small salmon caught in the Pacific and Great Lakes

examples.en: Anglers gathered by the river hoping to catch migrating coho salmon this autumn.
examples.zh: 垂钓者聚集在河边，希望在今年秋天捕获洄游的银大马哈鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coho 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外耳, 壳, 鼻甲, 甲, 半圆屋顶
lemmas.def_en: (anatomy) a structure that resembles a shell in shape

examples.en: The doctor examined the concha of the patient's ear to locate the painful swelling.
examples.zh: 医生检查了病人耳甲腔的部位，以确定疼痛肿胀的位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 concha 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女执事, 牧师的女助手
lemmas.def_en: a woman deacon

examples.en: The dedicated deaconess visited sick members of the congregation every Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 那位热心的女执事每个周日下午都会探望教会中生病的成员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deaconess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very spiny and dense evergreen shrub with fragrant golden-yellow flowers; common throughout western Europe

examples.en: The coastal hillside was covered in vibrant yellow gorse that smelled like coconut.
examples.zh: 沿海的山坡上长满了鲜黄色的荆豆花，散发着椰子般的香气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gorse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is weak and excessively sentimental

examples.en: Despite his intimidating appearance, the old coach is a complete softie at heart.
examples.zh: 尽管这位老教练外表吓人，但内心其实是个十足的心软之人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 softie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who is paralyzed in both arms and both legs

examples.en: Specialized voice-recognition software helped the quadriplegic author write his inspiring memoir.
examples.zh: 专门的语音识别软件帮助这位高位截瘫作者写下了他鼓舞人心的回忆录。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadriplegic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: internal organs collectively (especially those in the abdominal cavity)

examples.en: The sudden impact of the fall severely bruised several of his abdominal viscera.
examples.zh: 坠落造成的猛烈冲击严重挫伤了他的几处腹部内脏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viscera 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 红发的, 红头羽毛的
lemmas.def_en: having red hair and usually fair skin

examples.en: A cheerful redheaded girl waved excitedly to her parents from the school bus.
examples.zh: 一个欢快的红发女孩在校车上兴奋地向她的父母挥手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redheaded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a serration on a saw blade

examples.en: The graph displayed a sharp sawtooth pattern, reflecting the market's constant volatility.
examples.zh: 图表呈现出尖锐的锯齿状图案，反映了市场的持续波动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sawtooth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: leave immediately; used usually in the imperative form

examples.en: The shopkeeper told the loitering teenagers to scram before he called security.
examples.zh: 店主叫那些游荡的青少年在自己叫保安之前赶紧滚开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a meeting of spiritualists

examples.en: They gathered around the candlelit table hoping to contact spirits during the seance.
examples.zh: 他们围坐在点着蜡烛的桌旁，希望在降神会上与亡灵沟通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <非正>祖师爷, 老祖宗； 爷爷, 祖父
lemmas.def_en: the father of your father or mother

examples.en: This vintage mainframe computer is considered the granddaddy of all modern laptops.
examples.zh: 这台复古大型机被视为所有现代笔记本电脑的鼻祖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 granddaddy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who can be employed as a detective to collect information

examples.en: The private shamus waited in his parked car, watching the hotel entrance.
examples.zh: 那名私家侦探坐在停着的车里，紧盯着酒店入口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shamus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an open-air market in an Arabian city

examples.en: We spent hours bargaining for handmade carpets in the bustling Marrakech souk.
examples.zh: 我们在繁华的马拉喀什集市里花了几个小时淘选并讲价手工地毯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 souk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expectorated matter; saliva mixed with discharges from the respiratory passages; in ancient and medieval physiology it was believed to cause sluggishness

examples.en: The nurse collected a sputum sample to check for signs of infection.
examples.zh: 护士采集了痰液样本以检查是否存在感染迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sputum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a merchant who owns or manages a shop

examples.en: The friendly village storekeeper greeted every customer who walked through the door.
examples.zh: 这位友善的乡村店主向前来光顾的每位顾客热情打招呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 storekeeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having the shrewd resourcefulness needed to survive in an urban environment

examples.en: Growing up in a tough neighborhood made her streetwise and very independent.
examples.zh: 在环境艰苦的街区长大让她熟悉世故且非常独立。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 streetwise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lean flesh of any of numerous American perch-like fishes of the family Centrarchidae

examples.en: Divers were amazed to see a massive ocean sunfish gliding peacefully past.
examples.zh: 潜水员们惊奇地看到一只巨大的翻车鱼从容游过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic

examples.en: Traffic flowed smoothly along the newly constructed eight-lane coastal superhighway.
examples.zh: 新修建的八车道沿海超级高速公路上车辆通行顺畅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superhighway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or secreting synovia

examples.en: The doctor gave her an injection to supplement the synovial fluid inside.
examples.zh: 医生给她注射了药物，以补充关节腔内的滑液。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synovial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes

examples.en: The family usually gathers in the cozy parlor around four for teatime.
examples.zh: 全家人通常在四点左右聚集在舒适的客厅享用下午茶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teatime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: either of the sidelines in soccer or rugby

examples.en: The coach paced nervously along the touchline, shouting instructions to his players.
examples.zh: 教练在边线旁焦急地踱步，大声向球员们传达指令。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 touchline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: structure forming the transverse part of a cruciform church; crosses the nave at right angles

examples.en: Sunlight poured through the stained glass windows inside the cathedral's north transept.
examples.zh: 阳光穿透大教堂北侧耳堂的花窗玻璃洒了进来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transept 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: singer in a novel by George du Maurier who was under the control of the hypnotist Svengali

examples.en: The stylish gentleman tipped his brown trilby as he passed by us.
examples.zh: 那位风度翩翩的绅士走过我们身旁时，轻碰了一下他的棕色软毡帽致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trilby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 求面积, 正交, 弦
lemmas.def_en: the construction of a square having the same area as some other figure

examples.en: The engineer applied a classic numerical quadrature formula to estimate the curve.
examples.zh: 工程师应用经典的数值求积公式来估算该曲线的面积。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadrature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无家可归者, 无主物, 飘流物, 流浪者, 信号旗
lemmas.def_en: a homeless child especially one forsaken or orphaned

examples.en: The kind couple took in a hungry waif they found shivering outside.
examples.zh: 这对善良的夫妇收留了一个在外面冻得发抖的饥饿流浪儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waif 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sudden and decisive change of government illegally or by force

examples.en: The military putsch was swiftly crushed by forces loyal to the elected government.
examples.zh: 这场军事叛乱很快被忠于民选政府的军队平息了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 putsch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a portable enclosure in which babies may be left to play

examples.en: She placed the baby safely in the wooden playpen with some toys.
examples.zh: 她把婴儿安全地放在装有玩具的木制游戏围栏里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playpen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes or repairs guns

examples.en: The skilled gunsmith carefully cleaned and reassembled the antique hunting rifle.
examples.zh: 这位技艺精湛的枪匠仔细地清理并重新组装了那支老式猎枪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunsmith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a brush used to groom a person's hair

examples.en: She smoothed down her tangled curls using a gentle wooden hairbrush.
examples.zh: 她用一把温和的木制发刷梳平了打结的卷发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hairbrush 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a therapist who heals by the use of herbs

examples.en: The local herbalist prepared a soothing tea made from dried chamomile flowers.
examples.zh: 当地的草药医生用干甘菊配制了一种舒缓身心的茶饮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herbalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不允许的, 不许可的
lemmas.def_en: not permitted

examples.en: Using personal electronic devices during the exam is strictly impermissible under school rules.
examples.zh: 根据学校规定，考试期间严禁使用个人电子设备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impermissible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不妥协, 强硬, 不让步
lemmas.def_en: the trait of being intransigent; stubbornly refusing to compromise

examples.en: The peace talks collapsed due to the sheer intransigence of both political parties.
examples.zh: 由于双方政党的极度不妥协，和平谈判破裂了。

lemmas.def_en: impervious to pleas, persuasion, requests, reason; ; - W.Churchill

examples.en: Both sides remained intransigent, refusing to budge during the difficult peace negotiations.
examples.zh: 双方在艰难的和平谈判中都保持不妥协的立场，拒绝做出任何让步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intransigence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a toy wind instrument that has a membrane that makes a sound when you hum into the mouthpiece

examples.en: The little boy hummed a cheerful tune through his bright red plastic kazoo.
examples.zh: 小男孩用他鲜红色的塑料卡祖笛哼唱着欢快的曲调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kazoo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sailing vessel with two masts; the mizzen is forward of the rudderpost

examples.en: They spent the entire summer sailing their wooden ketch along the rugged coastline.
examples.zh: 他们整个夏天都驾驶着木质双桅纵帆船沿着崎岖的海岸线航行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ketch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a male massager

examples.en: The professional masseur used warm oils to ease the tension in her shoulders.
examples.zh: 专业男按摩师用温热的精油缓解了她肩膀的紧张感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 masseur 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 壁式烛台, 头, 头盔
lemmas.def_en: a shelter or screen providing protection from enemy fire or from the weather

examples.en: An antique brass sconce on the hallway wall cast a warm, flickering glow.
examples.zh: 走廊墙上古旧的黄铜壁灯投下温暖而摇曳的微光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sconce 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: informal terms for money

examples.en: He saved up enough moolah from his summer job to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 他用暑期工攒够了钱，买了一台新笔记本电脑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moolah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at no time hereafter;  -E.A.Poe

examples.en: The weary traveler vowed that he would nevermore return to that haunted valley.
examples.zh: 疲惫的旅人发誓他绝不再回到那个闹鬼的山谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nevermore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media

examples.en: The seasoned newspaperman chased down leads until he uncovered the full political scandal.
examples.zh: 这位经验丰富的新闻记者追查线索，直到揭露出整起政治丑闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newspaperman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 15th letter of the Greek alphabet

examples.en: The physics professor drew the symbol omicron carefully on the blackboard during class.
examples.zh: 物理教授在课堂上仔细地在黑板上画出了希腊字母 omicron。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 omicron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves)

examples.en: The elderly villagers spoke in a local patois that outsiders could hardly understand.
examples.zh: 老村民们说着一种外人几乎听不懂的当地土语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patois 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 幻想, 怪念头, 想象
lemmas.def_en: something many people believe that is false

examples.en: She retreated into a comforting world of phantasy whenever life became too stressful.
examples.zh: 每当现实压力过大时，她就会躲进令人安心的幻想世界中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phantasy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any polemoniaceous plant of the genus Phlox; chiefly North American; cultivated for their clusters of flowers

examples.en: Bright pink phlox bloomed abundantly along the stone pathway in her summer garden.
examples.zh: 夏日花园里的石径两旁，盛开着大片鲜艳的粉色福禄考。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phlox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 征途, 敌对行动, 敌对情绪
lemmas.def_en: hostile or belligerent mood

examples.en: The angry boss was on the warpath after discovering the costly shipping error.
examples.zh: 在发现代价高昂的运输失误后，愤怒的老板怒气冲冲地四处问责。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 warpath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy iron tool with a wooden handle and a curved head that is pointed on both ends

examples.en: The miner swung his heavy pickaxe against the rocky wall to extract coal.
examples.zh: 矿工挥动沉重的鹤嘴锄砸向岩壁以开采煤炭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pickaxe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: state unambiguously or remove ambiguities from

examples.en: The linguist added contextual clues to disambiguate the confusing sentence in the text.
examples.zh: 语言学家添加了语境线索，以消除文中那句令人费解之话的歧义。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 澄清, 清除二义性
lemmas.def_en: clarification that follows from the removal of ambiguity

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disambiguate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 合时地; 及时地; 合时令地; 应时地
lemmas.def_en: in accordance with the season

examples.en: The weather turned seasonably cold just as the vibrant autumn leaves began to fall.
examples.zh: 正当绚丽的秋叶开始飘落时，天气适时地转冷了。

lemmas.def_en: not in accordance with the season

examples.en: it was unseasonably cold

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seasonably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 驮篮, 挂蓝, 背篮, 肩筐, 裙撑
lemmas.def_en: either of a pair of bags or boxes hung over the rear wheel of a vehicle (as a bicycle)

examples.en: She packed a picnic blanket and some fresh fruit into her bicycle pannier.
examples.zh: 她把野餐毯和一些新鲜水果装进了自行车的挂囊里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pannier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pustule in an eruptive disease

examples.en: Years of heavy acne had left a tiny, noticeable pock on his cheek.
examples.zh: 多年的严重痤疮在他脸上留下了一个微小而明显的麻坑。

lemmas.def_en: mark with a scar

examples.en: Years of heavy acne had left a tiny, noticeable pock on his cheek.
examples.zh: 多年的严重痤疮在他脸上留下了一个微小而明显的麻坑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an unidentified (and possibly enemy) aircraft

examples.en: The fearful myth of the forest bogy kept children from wandering after dark.
examples.zh: 森林妖怪的可怕传说让孩子们不敢在天黑后乱跑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bogy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: memorial consisting of a very large stone forming part of a prehistoric structure (especially in western Europe)

examples.en: Tourists gathered around the ancient megalith to marvel at its mysterious, towering presence.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在古老巨石周围，惊叹于它神秘而高耸的英姿。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to megaliths or the people who erected megaliths

examples.en: megalithic monuments like Stonehenge

family_guide.root_logic: 以 megalith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal redness of the skin resulting from dilation of blood vessels (as in sunburn or inflammation)

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to the harsh sun resulted in severe erythema across his back.
examples.zh: 长时间暴露在烈日下导致他的背部出现了严重的红斑。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or characterized by erythema

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erythema 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 消除, 使清凉, 熄灭
lemmas.def_en: satisfy (thirst)

examples.en: A tall glass of iced lemonade helped to slake his thirst after the run.
examples.zh: 一大杯冰柠檬水帮他解了跑步后的口渴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诽谤, 中伤, 洒水
lemmas.def_en: a disparaging remark

examples.en: She refused to cast any aspersion on the integrity of her former colleagues.
examples.zh: 她拒绝诽谤以前同事的为人正直。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aspersion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 二分的, 叉状分枝的
lemmas.def_en: divided or dividing into two sharply distinguished parts or classifications

examples.en: The survey forced respondents to make a dichotomous choice between yes and no.
examples.zh: 该调查迫使受访者在“是”与“否”之间做出二选一的抉择。

lemmas.def_en: in a dichotomous manner

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dichotomous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the doughnut-shaped object enclosed by a torus

examples.en: The engineer wound the copper wire tightly around the magnetic toroid core.
examples.zh: 工程师将铜线紧紧缠绕在环形磁芯上。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or shaped like a toroid; doughnut shaped

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toroid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: talk in a tearful manner

examples.en: The spoiled child began to snivel when his mother took the candy away.
examples.zh: 当母亲拿走糖果时，那个被宠坏的孩子开始抽泣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snivel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 敲诈的, 勒索的, 过度的, 昂贵的
lemmas.def_en: greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation

examples.en: Local hotels charged extortionate prices during the peak of the summer festival.
examples.zh: 在夏季节日的高峰期，当地酒店收取了高得离谱的费用。

lemmas.def_en: to an exorbitant degree

examples.en: prices are exorbitantly high in the capital

family_guide.root_logic: 以 extortionate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having or showing an exaggerated opinion of your importance, ability, etc

examples.en: His immodest boast about his immense wealth annoyed everyone at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 他在餐桌上毫不谦虚地炫耀巨额财富，惹恼了所有人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不慎地; 不客气地; 不谦虚地; 不端庄地
lemmas.def_en: without modesty; in an immodest manner

examples.en: the book was entitled, immodestly, `All about Wisdom'

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immodest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergo vulcanization

examples.en: Manufacturers vulcanize natural rubber with sulfur to make it more durable and elastic.
examples.zh: 制造商用硫磺对天然橡胶进行硫化处理，以提高其耐用性和弹性。

lemmas.def_en: process of treating rubber or rubberlike materials with sulphur at great heat to improve elasticity and strength or to harden them

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vulcanize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an owner or tenant of a small farm in Great Britain

examples.en: The Scottish crofter worked hard every day to raise sheep on his small plot.
examples.zh: 这位苏格兰佃农每天辛勤劳作，在他狭小的土地上放羊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crofter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 烧灼, 烧灼器, 腐蚀
lemmas.def_en: an instrument or substance used to destroy tissue for medical reasons (eg removal of a wart) by burning it with a hot iron or an electric current or a caustic or by freezing it

examples.en: The surgeon used chemical cautery to quickly stop the bleeding from tiny vessels.
examples.zh: 外科医生使用化学烧灼法迅速止住了微血管的出血。

lemmas.def_en: the act of coagulating blood and destroying tissue with a hot iron or caustic agent or by freezing
burn, sear, or freeze (tissue) using a hot iron or electric current or a caustic agent

examples.en: The surgeon cauterized the wart

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cautery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使裸露, 剥下, 剥夺
lemmas.def_en: lay bare

examples.en: Decades of excessive logging have denuded the green hills of their ancient forests.
examples.zh: 数十年的过度采伐使这些原本葱郁的丘陵失去了古老的森林。

lemmas.def_zh: 滥伐, 剥夺, 剥蚀, 剥光
lemmas.def_en: the removal of covering

family_guide.root_logic: 以 denude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 口齿不清的, 说不出的, 难于言喻的
lemmas.def_en: without or deprived of the use of speech or words

examples.en: He was momentarily inarticulate with rage when he heard the shocking news.
examples.zh: 听到这个令人震惊的消息时，他愤怒得一时说不出话来。

lemmas.def_zh: 口齿不清地, 难以表达地, 笨嘴笨舌地
lemmas.def_en: without eloquence; in an inarticulate manner

examples.en: the freshman expresses his thoughts inarticulately

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inarticulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 党徒, 球迷, 坚决支持者, 党人, 党派分子, 敌后游击队员
lemmas.def_en: an ardent and enthusiastic supporter of some person or activity

examples.en: He remained a loyal partizan of the reform movement until his final days.
examples.zh: 直到生命的最后日子，他依然是这项改革运动的忠实支持者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 partizan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman with abnormal sexual desires

examples.en: The tabloid unfairly labeled the promiscuous celebrity as a nymphomaniac in the headlines.
examples.zh: 小报在头条新闻中不公正地将这位私生活混乱的名人归为性瘾者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nymphomaniac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <主苏>少年, 年青人,老弟(表示亲密的称呼)
lemmas.def_en: a male child (a familiar term of address to a boy)

examples.en: The old fisherman smiled and called the cheerful boy a clever little laddie.
examples.zh: 老渔夫微笑着称赞那个开朗的男孩是个聪明的小家伙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laddie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an event capable of causing a mutation

examples.en: Scientists used targeted mutagenesis to study the specific functions of the viral gene.
examples.zh: 科学家利用定点诱变技术来研究该病毒基因的具体功能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutagenesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a yellow trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group; occurs in monazite and bastnasite in association with cerium and lanthanum and praseodymium

examples.en: Powerful magnets made from neodymium are widely used in modern electric vehicle motors.
examples.zh: 由钕制成的强力磁铁被广泛应用于现代电动汽车电机中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neodymium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: class of small freeholders who cultivated their own land

examples.en: The local yeomanry took great pride in farming and defending their own lands.
examples.zh: 当地的自耕农们为耕种和保卫自己的土地感到无比自豪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yeomanry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (religion) the world of the dead; -Theognis

examples.en: Ancient myths often depict heroes descending bravely into the shadowy netherworld of spirits.
examples.zh: 古代神话经常描绘英雄们勇敢地潜入阴暗的亡灵阴界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 netherworld 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the nervous and endocrine systems (especially as they function together)

examples.en: Chronic stress can severely disrupt the body's delicate neuroendocrine balance over time.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，长期压力会严重破坏人体脆弱的神经内分泌平衡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neuroendocrine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft grey ductile metallic element used in alloys; occurs in niobite; formerly called columbium

examples.en: Adding a small amount of niobium makes the steel alloy much stronger and heat-resistant.
examples.zh: 添加少量的铌可以使钢合金变得更加坚固且耐热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 niobium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nocturnal wildcat of Central America and South America having a dark-spotted buff-brown coat

examples.en: The elusive ocelot rested silently high in the branches of the dense rainforest.
examples.zh: 那只行踪隐秘的豹猫静静地在茂密雨林的高枝上休息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ocelot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 根深的, 成癖的, 积习的
lemmas.def_en: habitual

examples.en: My uncle is an inveterate gambler who simply cannot walk past a casino.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是个积习难改的赌徒，路过赌场就挪不动步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inveterate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an outcome (good or bad) that is well deserved

examples.en: The arrogant bully finally received his comeuppance when he was expelled from school.
examples.zh: 那个傲慢的恶霸最终遭到了应有的报应，被学校开除了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 comeuppance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: farthest to the west

examples.en: They traveled to the westernmost point of the island to watch the sunset.
examples.zh: 他们前往该岛的最西端欣赏日落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 westernmost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 要哭的, 眼泪汪汪的
lemmas.def_en: liable to weep easily

examples.en: She always gets a little weepy whenever she watches romantic comedy films.
examples.zh: 每当看浪漫喜剧电影时，她总是会眼泪汪汪的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weepy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acquired skin disease characterized by patches of unpigmented skin (often surrounded by a heavily pigmented border)

examples.en: The model proudly displayed the white patches caused by vitiligo on her skin.
examples.zh: 这位模特自豪地展现了皮肤上由白癜风引起的白斑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vitiligo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of oxalic acid

examples.en: Foods high in oxalate can contribute to the formation of painful kidney stones.
examples.zh: 草酸盐含量高的食物可能会导致形成痛苦的肾结石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oxalate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: artificial and inferior

examples.en: During the war, people had to drink ersatz coffee made from roasted acorns.
examples.zh: 战争期间，人们不得不饮用由烤橡子制成的劣质代用咖啡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ersatz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凝乳食品, 用公费游山玩水, 宴请
lemmas.def_en: dessert made of sweetened milk coagulated with rennet

examples.en: The senator faced harsh criticism for taking an expensive junket to the Caribbean.
examples.zh: 这位参议员因公费前往加勒比海豪华游乐而面临严厉批评。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 junket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 龄(幼虫两次蜕皮间的虫期)
lemmas.def_en: an insect or other arthropod between molts

examples.en: The caterpillar sheds its outer skin before entering its final developmental instar.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫在进入最后一个发育虫龄前会褪去外皮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 instar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 镇纸, 压纸物, 压纸器
lemmas.def_en: a weight used to hold down a stack of papers

examples.en: A heavy glass paperweight kept the legal documents from blowing off the desk.
examples.zh: 一个厚重的玻璃镇纸防止了法律文件被从桌上吹走。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paperweight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Japanese cheer of enthusiasm or triumph

examples.en: The crowd shouted banzai as the emperor appeared on the palace balcony.
examples.zh: 当皇帝出现在皇宫阳台上时，人群高呼万岁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 banzai 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 易怒的, 倔强的, 脾气不好的
lemmas.def_en: stubbornly resistant to authority or control

examples.en: The lack of sleep made the children fractious and difficult to manage.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让孩子们变得烦躁易怒，难以管教。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fractious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pasture grass of plains of South America and western North America

examples.en: The ancient Latin prescription clearly specified a single gramma of the powdered herb.
examples.zh: 这副古老的拉丁处方明确规定只需要一克这种草药粉末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gramma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fight involving shooting small arms with the intent to kill or frighten

examples.en: The peaceful neighborhood was suddenly shattered by violent and unexpected gunplay last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚突如其来的激烈枪战打破了这个平静街区的安宁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunplay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有条理的, 有效率的
lemmas.def_en: exhibiting methodical and systematic characteristics that would be useful in business

examples.en: She handled the difficult contract negotiations in a calm and businesslike manner.
examples.zh: 她以冷静且高效有条理的方式处理了艰难的合同谈判。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 businesslike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: largest North American frog; highly aquatic with a deep-pitched voice

examples.en: A large bullfrog leaped off the muddy bank and splashed into the pond.
examples.zh: 一只大牛蛙跳下泥泞的河岸，溅着水花落入池塘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullfrog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鲱鱼鱼骨, 交叉缝式, 人字形
lemmas.def_en: a twilled fabric with a herringbone pattern

examples.en: The stylish apartment featured an elegant oak floor laid in a herringbone pattern.
examples.zh: 这间时尚的公寓铺设了优雅的人字形橡木地板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herringbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cry of praise or adoration (to God)

examples.en: The church choir sang hosanna as the festive morning service came to an end.
examples.zh: 随着节日早晨礼拜的结束，教堂唱诗班唱起了和撒那。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hosanna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一种纸牌戏(由二至四人玩)
lemmas.def_en: a card game in which cards face up on the table are taken with eligible cards in the hand

examples.en: The two elderly friends spent their rainy afternoon playing a quiet game of cassino.
examples.zh: 这两位老朋友在下雨的午后玩了一局安静的卡西诺纸牌戏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cassino 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a morbid fear of open spaces (as fear of being caught alone in some public place)

examples.en: His severe agoraphobia prevented him from leaving the safety of his own home.
examples.zh: 他严重的广场恐怖症使他无法离开自己安全的家。

lemmas.def_zh: 广场恐怖的, 旷野恐怖的, 恐旷症的, 陌生环境恐怖的
lemmas.def_en: suffering from agoraphobia; abnormally afraid of open or public places

examples.en: Severe agoraphobic panic prevented her from stepping outside into the crowded and noisy square.
examples.zh: 严重的旷野恐惧症发作，使她无法迈步踏入拥挤嘈杂的广场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agoraphobia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally high body temperature; sometimes induced (as in treating some forms of cancer)

examples.en: The desert hiker suffered from life-threatening hyperthermia after running out of water.
examples.zh: 这名沙漠徒步者在水耗尽后面临危及生命的高热症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperthermia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an overactive thyroid gland; pathologically excessive production of thyroid hormones or the condition resulting from excessive production of thyroid hormones

examples.en: Rapid weight loss and anxiety can be common symptoms of untreated hyperthyroidism.
examples.zh: 体重迅速减轻和焦虑可能是未治疗的甲状腺功能亢进症的常见症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperthyroidism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bearing or containing fossils

examples.en: The geologists examined the fossiliferous limestone layers exposed along the coastal cliff.
examples.zh: 地质学家们检查了沿海悬崖上裸露的富含化石的石灰岩层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fossiliferous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (biochemistry) purine base found in DNA and RNA; pairs with thymine in DNA and with uracil in RNA

examples.en: Adenine always pairs with thymine in the double helix structure of DNA.
examples.zh: 在DNA的双螺旋结构中，腺嘌呤总是与胸腺嘧啶配对。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adenine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 去不掉, 擦不掉, 洗不掉, 持久
lemmas.def_en: in an indelible manner

examples.en: The traumatic childhood experience was indelibly stamped into his lifelong memory.
examples.zh: 那段童年创伤经历不可磨灭地印刻在了他一生的记忆中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indelibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ordinal number of forty in counting order

examples.en: Today marks the company's fortieth anniversary of providing exceptional service worldwide.
examples.zh: 今天标志着该公司在全球提供卓越服务的第四十个年头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fortieth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the second period of the Stone Age (following the eolithic)

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered several palaeolithic stone tools inside the remote mountain cave.
examples.zh: 考古学家在偏远山洞中发现了几件旧石器时代的石器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palaeolithic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 专爱唱反调的, 爱吵架的
lemmas.def_en: stubbornly obstructive and unwilling to cooperate; - Spectator

examples.en: The cantankerous old man constantly yelled at neighbors who walked past his lawn.
examples.zh: 那个脾气暴躁的老头经常对经过他草坪的邻居大喊大叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantankerous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the enteron

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an enteric-coated tablet to protect the patient's stomach lining.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种肠溶片以保护患者的胃黏膜。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the enteron

examples.en: The critically ill patient received essential nutrients through an enteral feeding tube yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午，该危重患者通过肠内营养管获得了必需的营养。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enteric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (chemistry) the property of certain substances that enables them to exist in two distinct crystalline forms

examples.en: Sexual dimorphism is evident in bird species where males display brighter plumage.
examples.zh: 雌雄二态性在雄性拥有更亮丽羽毛的鸟类中尤为明显。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dimorphism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: suggesting the operation of supernatural influences; ; ; - John Galsworthy; ; - Henry Kingsley

examples.en: An eldritch shriek echoed through the abandoned mansion, terrifying everyone present.
examples.zh: 一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫在废弃的宅邸中回荡，吓坏了在场的所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eldritch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 电信会议, 远程会议
lemmas.def_en: a conference of people who are in different locations that is made possible by the use of such telecommunications equipment as closed-circuit television

examples.en: Our regional managers held a teleconference to discuss the upcoming product launch.
examples.zh: 我们的区域经理举行了一次远程会议，讨论即将推出的新产品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teleconference 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 谨小慎微的, 大惊小怪的, 为小事挂虑的
lemmas.def_en: exaggeratedly proper

examples.en: He hated wearing a tie because it made him feel too prissy.
examples.zh: 他讨厌系领带，因为那让他觉得自己太做作拘谨了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prissy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any igneous rock with crystals embedded in a finer groundmass of minerals

examples.en: Ancient Roman sculptors favored red porphyry for carving imperial statues and monuments.
examples.zh: 古罗马雕塑家偏爱用红色斑岩雕刻帝国雕像和纪念碑。

lemmas.def_en: (of rocks) consisting of porphyry or containing large crystals in a fine groundmass of minerals

examples.en: The geologist examined a porphyritic rock containing large quartz crystals embedded in basalt.
examples.zh: 地质学家检查了一块嵌在玄武岩中的含有大石英晶体的斑岩状岩石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 porphyry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: possessing a differential coefficient or derivative

examples.en: In calculus, we learned that every differentiable function is necessarily a continuous function.
examples.zh: 在微积分中，我们学到了每一个可微函数必然是连续函数。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 differentiable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute two-winged insect that sucks the blood of mammals and birds and other insects

examples.en: We sat by the campfire while tiny punky bites left our arms itchy.
examples.zh: 我们坐在篝火旁，被微小的蠓虫叮咬得手臂发痒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 punky 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: manufactured in standard sizes to be shipped and assembled elsewhere

examples.en: Workers quickly assembled the prefab classroom units to accommodate the incoming students.
examples.zh: 工人们迅速组装了预制教室单元，以容纳即将入学的新生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prefab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: composed of aggregates of crystals

examples.en: The engineer chose polycrystalline silicon panels to reduce manufacturing costs significantly.
examples.zh: 工程师选择了多晶硅电池板，以显著降低制造成本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polycrystalline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用户直通电报, 电传打字机
lemmas.def_en: a character printer connected to a telegraph that operates like a typewriter

examples.en: The overseas office sent an urgent telex confirming the delivery of the cargo.
examples.zh: 海外办事处发来一份紧急电传，确认了货物的交付。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 针头, 小东西, 微不足道的东西
lemmas.def_en: an ignorant or foolish person

examples.en: The microchip contains microscopic circuits that are no larger than a pinhead.
examples.zh: 该微芯片包含仅有针头大小的微观电路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 矮林, 小灌木林, 萌生林
lemmas.def_en: a dense growth of bushes

examples.en: A small herd of deer fled into the copse when the dog barked.
examples.zh: 狗叫时，一小群鹿逃进了小灌木林中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 copse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不快, 生气, 阴影, 树荫, 怀疑等模糊感觉
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of anger caused by being offended

examples.en: She took umbrage at his sarcastic remark and walked out of the room.
examples.zh: 她对他的冷嘲热讽感到不悦，随即走出了房间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 umbrage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 脂肪的, 脂肪质的, 分泌脂肪的
lemmas.def_en: containing an unusual amount of grease or oil

examples.en: Overactive sebaceous glands on the face often lead to clogged pores and acne.
examples.zh: 面部皮脂腺分泌过盛常会导致毛孔堵塞并引发痤疮。

lemmas.def_en: the oily secretion of the sebaceous glands; with perspiration it moistens and protects the skin

examples.en: Excessive production of sebum can clog pores and lead to severe skin breakouts.
examples.zh: 皮脂分泌过剩会堵塞毛孔，并导致严重的皮肤爆痘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sebaceous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不调和, 不一致, 不和谐
lemmas.def_en: a lack of harmony

examples.en: Unresolved financial troubles caused severe disharmony and tension within the family.
examples.zh: 未解决的财务危机在家庭内部引发了严重的不和与紧张局势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disharmony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动]银背大猩猩(指背部颈下方有银白色毛的雄性成年大猩猩)
lemmas.def_en: an adult male gorilla with grey hairs across the back

examples.en: A powerful silverback gorilla stood guard while the rest of his troop rested.
examples.zh: 一只强壮的银背大猩猩在其余族群成员休息时放哨守卫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silverback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the peritoneum

examples.en: A ruptured appendix can lead to peritonitis if it is not treated immediately.
examples.zh: 如果阑尾破裂不立即治疗，可能会引发腹膜炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peritonitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of a hammerhead opposite the flat striking surface (may have various shapes)

examples.en: He used the rounded ball peen of the hammer to shape the metal.
examples.zh: 他使用锤子的圆顶端来对金属进行塑形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood of a sumac

examples.en: Brilliant red leaves appeared on the staghorn sumac as autumn arrived.
examples.zh: 秋天来临之际，鹿角漆树上长出了鲜艳的红叶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sumac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: forbidden to profane use especially in South Pacific islands

examples.en: Discussing personal finances openly was once considered strictly tabu in their community.
examples.zh: 在他们的群体中，公开谈论个人财务曾被严格视为禁忌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restaurant where tea and light meals are available

examples.en: We spent a rainy afternoon chatting quietly inside an old wooden teahouse.
examples.zh: 我们在一家老旧的木制茶室里静静闲聊，度过了一个雨后下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teahouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无防御的, 无论据证实的, 无辩护人的
lemmas.def_en: not defended or capable of being defended

examples.en: The coastal town was left completely undefended after the troops suddenly withdrew.
examples.zh: 部队突然撤离后，这座沿海小镇完全陷入了无防备状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undefended 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能想像地；难以理解地
lemmas.def_en: to an unimaginable extent

examples.en: Deep space is unimaginably vast, stretching far beyond what our minds can grasp.
examples.zh: 深空广袤得难以想象，远远超出了人类心智所能理解的范围。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unimaginably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: become gelatinous

examples.en: The leftover bacon grease began to congeal into a thick white paste.
examples.zh: 吃剩的培根油脂开始凝结成厚厚的白色膏状物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congeal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing frivolous or superficial interest; amateurish

examples.en: Critics dismissed his musical efforts as the work of an arrogant dilettante.
examples.zh: 批评家们对他的音乐尝试不屑一顾，认为只是自大业余者的玩票之作。

lemmas.def_en: an amateur who engages in an activity without serious intentions and who pretends to have knowledge

examples.en: Critics dismissed his musical efforts as the work of an arrogant dilettante.
examples.zh: 批评家们对他的音乐尝试不屑一顾，认为只是自大业余者的玩票之作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dilettante 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 上衣后摆, 燕尾服的燕尾
lemmas.def_en: the loose back flap of a coat that hangs below the waist

examples.en: He managed to win the congressional seat primarily by riding the president's coattails.
examples.zh: 他主要依靠沾总统的光，才成功赢得了国会席位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coattail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a now abandoned study of the shape of skull as indicative of the strengths of different faculties

examples.en: Nineteenth-century doctors once treated phrenology as a legitimate branch of medical science.
examples.zh: 19世纪的医生曾将颅相学视为医学的一个正统分支。

lemmas.def_en: someone who claims to be able to read your character from the shape of your skull
of or relating to phrenology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phrenology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an insubstantial or vague semblance

examples.en: The themed resort felt like a cheap simulacrum of an authentic European village.
examples.zh: 这个主题度假村感觉就像是对真正欧洲乡村的拙劣仿造。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 simulacrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侧线, 侧灯, 舷灯, 杂闻
lemmas.def_en: light carried by a boat that indicates the boat's direction; vessels at night carry a red light on the port bow and a green light on the starboard bow

examples.en: Her private diary provides a fascinating sidelight on the famous political scandal.
examples.zh: 她的私人日记为那桩著名的政治丑闻提供了一个有趣的侧面视角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sidelight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 灵巧的, 惯用右手的
lemmas.def_en: skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands

examples.en: The surgeon used dexterous hand movements to repair the tiny severed nerve quickly.
examples.zh: 外科医生用灵巧的手法迅速修复了那根细小的断裂神经。

lemmas.def_en: with dexterity; in a dexterous manner

examples.en: dextrously he untied the knots

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dexterous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the form of theological rationalism that believes in God on the basis of reason without reference to revelation

examples.en: Many leading figures of the Enlightenment embraced deism rather than orthodox Christianity.
examples.zh: 启蒙运动时期的许多代表人物信奉自然神论，而非正统基督教。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to deism

examples.en: His deist beliefs led him to view the universe as a self-sustaining machine.
examples.zh: 他的自然神论信仰使他将宇宙视为一台自我维持的机器。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to deism

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) a doctrine explaining phenomena by their ends or purposes

examples.en: Modern evolutionary biologists generally reject teleology when explaining how complex traits develop.
examples.zh: 现代进化生物学家在解释复杂性状如何形成时，普遍摒弃目的论。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to teleology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teleology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the doctrine that all natural objects and the universe itself have souls

examples.en: The ancient tribe practiced animism, believing spirits inhabited the trees and rocks.
examples.zh: 这个古老的部落信奉万物有灵论，认为树木和岩石中都寄居着神灵。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the doctrine of animism

examples.en: The isolated indigenous tribe preserved their traditional animist beliefs about sacred forests.
examples.zh: 这个孤立的原住民部落保留了他们关于神圣森林的传统泛灵论信仰。

lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the doctrine of animism

family_guide.root_logic: 以 animism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: local names for a cowboy (`vaquero' is used especially in southwestern and central Texas and `buckaroo' is used especially in California)

examples.en: The experienced vaquero expertly roped the runaway steer on the dusty plain.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的牛仔在尘土飞扬的平原上熟练地用绳套套住了逃跑的小牛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vaquero 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: skill in preparing mixed drinks

examples.en: He studied the subtle art of mixology before opening his trendy cocktail lounge.
examples.zh: 在开这家时髦的鸡尾酒吧之前，他潜心研究了精妙的调酒艺术。

lemmas.def_zh: 酒吧调酒员, 酒吧招待
lemmas.def_en: an employee who mixes and serves alcoholic drinks at a bar

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mixology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a merchant who sells writing materials and office supplies

examples.en: I bought high-quality fountain pen ink from a local stationer downtown yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在市中心的一家本地文具店买了一瓶优质钢笔墨水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stationer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sour or bitter in taste

examples.en: The film critic was widely known for her witty yet acerbic movie reviews.
examples.zh: 这位影评人以其风趣却尖刻的电影评论而闻名遐迩。

lemmas.def_en: a sharp bitterness

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acerbic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: British soldier; so-called because of his red coat (especially during the American Revolution)

examples.en: Colonial militia fired upon the retreating redcoats from behind stone walls.
examples.zh: 殖民地民兵从石墙后方向撤退的英国士兵开火射击。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redcoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 毂盖, (美)(非正式)骄傲自大的人
lemmas.def_en: cap that fits over the hub of a wheel

examples.en: The rusty old hubcap flew off the wheel as the car hit a pothole.
examples.zh: 汽车撞上路面坑洼时，生锈的旧轮毂盖从车轮上飞了出去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hubcap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无性的, 中性的, 无性别的, 缺乏性感的, 性欲冷淡的
lemmas.def_en: having no or imperfectly developed or nonfunctional sex organs

examples.en: The android wore a plain white tunic that gave it a completely sexless look.
examples.zh: 那个仿生人穿着一件纯白外衣，显得毫无性别特征。

lemmas.def_en: having no evident sex or sex organs

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sexless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 导师, 教师, 校长, 圣殿骑士地方分团团长
lemmas.def_en: teacher at a university or college (especially at Cambridge or Oxford)

examples.en: The young medical intern shadowed his preceptor throughout the busy night shift.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的实习医生在繁忙的夜班期间一直跟随着他的指导老师。

lemmas.def_en: the position of preceptor

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preceptor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a block made from charcoal or coal dust and burned as fuel

examples.en: He arranged charcoal briquettes evenly in the grill before lighting the backyard fire.
examples.zh: 在点燃后院的炉火前，他把炭块均匀地摆放在烤架里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 briquette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make less humid

examples.en: We bought a powerful portable machine to dehumidify the damp basement quickly.
examples.zh: 我们买了一台大功率便携设备，以便迅速为潮湿的地下室除湿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dehumidify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: confirm again

examples.en: Please call the airline office to reconfirm your international flight reservation tomorrow.
examples.zh: 请明天致电航空公司办公室，再次确认您的国际航班预订。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reconfirm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 苦鲁病, 新几内亚震颤病
lemmas.def_en: a progressive disease of the central nervous system marked by increasing lack of coordination and advancing to paralysis and death within a year of the appearance of symptoms; thought to have been transmitted by cannibalistic consumption of diseased brain tissue since the disease virtually disappeared when cannibalism was abandoned

examples.en: Researchers studied kuru to understand how infectious prions transmit neurological diseases.
examples.zh: 研究人员通过研究库鲁病来了解传染性朊病毒如何传播神经系统疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kuru 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: provide (books) with blank leaves

examples.en: The printer allows you to interleave blank sheets between printed slides.
examples.zh: 这台打印机允许你在打印好的幻灯片之间插入空白纸张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interleave 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who violates the law

examples.en: The surveillance cameras helped the police identify and arrest the persistent lawbreaker.
examples.zh: 监控摄像头帮助警方指认并逮捕了那名惯犯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lawbreaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 关系密切的, 有关的, 同样的, 恰当的, 贴切的
lemmas.def_en: relevant and appropriate

examples.en: Please keep your remarks germane to the specific topic under discussion today.
examples.zh: 请确保您的发言与今天讨论的具体议题密切相关。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 germane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a low seat or a stool to rest the feet of a seated person

examples.en: He kicked off his shoes and rested his tired feet on a footstool.
examples.zh: 他踢掉鞋子，把疲惫的双脚搭在脚凳上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 footstool 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: decision making by a group (especially in a manner that discourages creativity or individual responsibility)

examples.en: The committee suffered from groupthink, rejecting any ideas that challenged the consensus.
examples.zh: 该委员会陷入了群体盲思，拒绝接受任何挑战共识的观点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groupthink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冷淡地, 枯躁无味地
lemmas.def_en: in a dry laconic manner;  he said dryly

examples.en: "That went well," she remarked dryly after the disastrous client meeting.
examples.zh: 灾难般的客户会议结束后，她冷淡地讽刺道：“进展真顺利。”

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dryly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the region adjacent to a boat dock

examples.en: Workers loaded heavy shipping containers onto the cargo vessel at the dockside.
examples.zh: 工人们在码头边将沉重的集装箱装上货船。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dockside 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small worthless amount

examples.en: Despite working all weekend on the proposal, he earned diddly for his efforts.
examples.zh: 尽管整个周末都在赶方案，他的辛劳却没有换来一文钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diddly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 确定的, 坚决的, 决定的
lemmas.def_en: precisely determined or limited or defined; especially fixed by rule or by a specific and constant cause

examples.en: The contract states that the project must be completed within a determinate timeframe.
examples.zh: 合同规定该项目必须在明确的时间期限内完成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 determinate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tendency to believe readily

examples.en: Dishonest salespeople often prey upon the credulity of unsuspecting elderly customers.
examples.zh: 不诚实的销售人员常常利用毫无戒备的老年顾客的轻信。

lemmas.def_en: disposed to believe on little evidence

examples.en: Credulous investors lost their savings after falling for the obvious online financial scam.
examples.zh: 轻信的投资者落入了显而易见的反常网络金融骗局，赔光了积蓄。

lemmas.def_en: in a credulous manner

examples.en: the children followed the teacher credulously

family_guide.root_logic: 以 credulity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards

examples.en: His heterodox economic theories challenged many long-standing principles of modern capitalism.
examples.zh: 他那非正统的经济理论对现代资本主义的诸多长期原则提出了挑战。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heterodox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving or causing hemolysis

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with a rare hemolytic disorder that destroyed red blood cells.
examples.zh: 该患者被诊断出患有一种破坏红细胞的罕见溶血性疾病。

lemmas.def_en: lysis of erythrocytes with the release of hemoglobin

examples.en: Improper handling of the delicate blood sample can easily cause hemolysis and skew lab results.
examples.zh: 对脆弱的血液样本处理不当很容易引起溶血，从而影响化验结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemolytic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 温文有礼的, 高兴的
lemmas.def_en: having a sophisticated charm

examples.en: The debonair actor charmed everyone as he walked gracefully down the red carpet.
examples.zh: 这位举止优雅潇洒的男演员走上红地毯时迷倒了所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 debonair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: determining the location of something by measuring the time it takes for an echo to return from it

examples.en: Bats navigate through pitch-black caves using high-frequency echolocation rather than vision.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠依靠高频回声定位而非视觉在漆黑的洞穴中穿行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 echolocation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象蒙古人的, 蒙古人种的, 先天愚型的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or resembling a Mongol

examples.en: Early anthropologists used the term mongoloid to classify specific populations across Asia.
examples.zh: 早期的体质人类学家曾使用蒙古人种这一术语来对亚洲的特定人群进行分类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mongoloid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a holdup man who stops a vehicle and steals from it

examples.en: The masked highwayman ambushed the horse-drawn carriage along the dark forest road.
examples.zh: 蒙面拦路强盗在黑暗的林间小路上伏击了那辆马车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 highwayman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a songbook containing a collection of hymns

examples.en: The choir members opened the hymnal to sing the traditional opening anthem.
examples.zh: 合唱团成员翻开赞美诗集，唱起传统的开场圣歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hymnal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [宗]天课,扎卡特(伊斯兰教徒每年一次的慈善捐款)
lemmas.def_en: the fourth pillar of Islam is almsgiving as an act of worship

examples.en: Devout Muslims calculate and pay zakat annually to support the impoverished community.
examples.zh: 虔诚的穆斯林每年计算并缴纳天课，以扶助贫困群体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zakat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the cultivation of grapes and grape vines; grape growing

examples.en: The region is internationally celebrated for its exceptional viticulture and premium wines.
examples.zh: 该地区以其卓越的葡萄栽培技术和优质葡萄酒而享誉国际。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viticulture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 迅猛龙（二足、肉食性的有羽毛恐龙, 能高速奔跑。电影《侏罗纪公园》系列中的重要角色）; 速龙; 伶盗龙
lemmas.def_en: small active carnivore that probably fed on protoceratops; possibly related more closely to birds than to other dinosaurs

examples.en: Popular movies often depict the velociraptor as much larger than its actual fossil size.
examples.zh: 流行电影中描绘的迅猛龙往往比其实际的化石体型大得多。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 velociraptor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act or process of determining the time

examples.en: Strict timekeeping is essential for ensuring that all scheduled trains depart promptly.
examples.zh: 严格的考勤与计时对于确保所有班次列车准点发车至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 timekeeping 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 像公牛的, 金牛座的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or resembling a bull

examples.en: The fierce wrestler was known for his broad shoulders and taurine physical strength.
examples.zh: 这位凶猛的摔跤手以其宽阔的双肩和如公牛般的力量而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taurine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 巢菜, 稗子, 皮重
lemmas.def_en: an adjustment made for the weight of the packaging in order to determine the net weight of the goods

examples.en: Be sure to measure the tare of the container before adding any liquid.
examples.zh: 在倒入液体之前，请务必先称量容器的皮重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a red light on the rear of a motor vehicle that signals when the brakes are applied to slow or stop

examples.en: He hit the brakes hard when the stoplight suddenly turned red.
examples.zh: 当交通信号灯突然变红时，他猛踩了刹车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stoplight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嬉戏着的, 戏谑的, 闹着玩的, 运动的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or interested in sports

examples.en: Two sportive dolphins leapt gracefully alongside our boat during the sunset cruise.
examples.zh: 在日落巡航中，两只嬉戏的海豚在我们的船边优雅地跃起。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sportive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fodder harvested while green and kept succulent by partial fermentation as in a silo

examples.en: The farmer stored fermented grass as silage to feed the cows all winter.
examples.zh: 农夫储存了发酵草料作为青贮饲料，以供奶牛过冬食用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a variety of mandarin orange

examples.en: She packed a sweet, easy-to-peel satsuma in her bag for a midday snack.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 satsuma 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: In Buddhist philosophy, wisdom is the only path to escape the cycle of samsara.

family_guide.root_logic: 以 samsara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 脊线；山脊线；脊线评测

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pompadour 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ornery 为核心的派生词族。

examples.en: The high-speed maglev train glides smoothly above its tracks using powerful magnets.
examples.zh: 高速磁悬浮列车利用强力磁铁在轨道上方平稳滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maglev 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: somewhat long

examples.en: After a longish silence, she finally agreed to sign the peace treaty.
examples.zh: 在一段稍显漫长的沉默之后，她终于同意签署和平协议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 linchpin 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 laughably 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 imago 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 domine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有女人腔的, 懦弱的

family_guide.root_logic: 以 showboat 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 该化石展示了一块保存极其完好的古代海洋爬行动物椎体。
