lemmas.def_en: sauce for pasta; contains eggs and bacon or ham and grated cheese

examples.en: He ordered a rich plate of spaghetti carbonara with crispy cured pork.
examples.zh: 他点了一盘浓郁的培根蛋面，上面配有香脆的腌制猪肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carbonara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过于丰富(或充足), 过多
lemmas.def_en: the state of being more than full

examples.en: The garden produced an overabundance of ripe tomatoes this unusually sunny summer.
examples.zh: 在这个格外晴朗的夏天，菜园里产出了过多的成熟番茄。

lemmas.def_en: excessively abundant

examples.en: The garden suffered from an overabundant growth of weeds after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，花园里杂草疯长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overabundance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 矫形术, 矫形外科学, 矫形学, 矫正术
lemmas.def_en: the branch of medical science concerned with disorders or deformities of the spine and joints

examples.en: The hospital has gained national recognition for its advanced work in pediatric orthopaedics.
examples.zh: 该医院在小儿矫形外科学方面的先进成果赢得了全国认可。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 orthopaedics 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: transformation of a substance produced by the action of heat

examples.en: Plastic waste can be converted into useful industrial fuel through high-temperature pyrolysis.
examples.zh: 塑料废弃物可以通过高温热解转化为有用的工业燃料。

lemmas.def_en: resulting from pyrolysis

examples.en: The factory uses a high-temperature pyrolytic process to recycle waste plastics efficiently.
examples.zh: 该工厂利用高温热解工艺高效回收废弃塑料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyrolysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 全套披甲, 全幅盔甲, 华服美饰
lemmas.def_en: a complete and impressive array

examples.en: The museum displayed a stunning panoply of medieval armor and royal ceremonial robes.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了令人惊叹的全套中世纪盔甲和皇家礼服。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 panoply 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用于导航的雷达和电视设备
lemmas.def_en: a switch made from the stems of the rattan palms

examples.en: The coastal station used an experimental ratan system to guide ships through dense fog.
examples.zh: 沿海电台使用实验性雷达电视导航系统引导船只穿过浓雾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ratan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a pair of loose trousers tied by a drawstring around the waist; worn by men and women in some Asian countries

examples.en: He lounged comfortably in his silk pyjama bottoms all Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 整个周日早晨，他都舒服地穿着丝绸睡裤闲逛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyjama 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large and brightly colored handkerchief; often used as a neckerchief

examples.en: She tied a red paisley bandanna around her head to keep the sweat away.
examples.zh: 她在头上系了一条红色佩斯利花纹手帕以擦拭汗水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bandanna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by spirited enjoyment

examples.en: The baker explained that adding fresh barmy yeast is essential for authentic crusty bread.
examples.zh: 面包师解释说，添加新鲜的发酵酵母对于制作地道脆皮面包至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barmy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broadcast that repeated at a later time

examples.en: Tune in tonight for a special rebroadcast of the championship game on channel five.
examples.zh: 今晚请锁定五频道收看这场冠军赛的特别重播。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rebroadcast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 系铃带头羊, 前导, 领导者
lemmas.def_en: someone who assumes leadership of a movement or activity

examples.en: Analysts view the tech giant as a reliable bellwether for the entire national economy.
examples.zh: 分析人士将这家科技巨头视为整个国民经济可靠的晴雨表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bellwether 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <日>n.(大拇趾单独分开的)日本式厚底短袜[日文汉字：足袋]
lemmas.def_en: a sock with a separation for the big toe; worn with thong sandals by the Japanese

examples.en: She slipped into traditional white tabi socks before putting on her wooden sandals.
examples.zh: 穿上木屐前，她穿上了传统的白色分趾袜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: yellowwood tree with brittle wood and aromatic leaves and bark; source of sassafras oil; widely distributed in eastern North America

examples.en: The fragrant scent of wild sassafras roots drifted through the dense autumn forest.
examples.zh: 野生黄樟树根的芳香在茂密的秋日森林中弥漫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sassafras 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shelter for birds

examples.en: My grandfather built a charming wooden birdhouse and hung it from the old oak.
examples.zh: 我祖父做了一个精致的木制鸟舍，并把它挂在老橡树上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 birdhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution

examples.en: He unfolded the morning broadsheet over coffee to read the in-depth political analysis.
examples.zh: 他一边喝咖啡一边翻开晨间大报，阅读深度政治分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broadsheet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one who is playfully mischievous

examples.en: The playful little scamp hid his sister's favorite doll behind the sofa cushions.
examples.zh: 那个顽皮的小淘气把妹妹最喜欢的洋娃娃藏在沙发垫后面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scamp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: colorless pungent crystalline compound derived from capsicum; source of the hotness of hot peppers of the genus Capsicum such as chili and cayenne and jalapeno

examples.en: Gloves are recommended when handling hot peppers because the potent capsaicin burns bare skin.
examples.zh: 处理辣椒时建议戴手套，因为强效辣椒素会灼伤裸露的皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capsaicin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冗长的文章, (瓦工用的)抹灰靠尺
lemmas.def_en: a long monotonous harangue

examples.en: The disgruntled employee posted an angry, five-page screed attacking company management online.
examples.zh: 那位心怀不满的员工在网上发布了一篇长达五页的愤怒长文，抨击公司管理层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 screed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of making a noisy disturbance

examples.en: The unruly puppies caused a massive rumpus in the living room while chasing balls.
examples.zh: 几只不听话的小狗在客厅追球时引起了一场大喧闹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rumpus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有地方色彩, 土话, 方言, 地方主义
lemmas.def_en: a phrase or pronunciation that is peculiar to a particular locality

examples.en: The author captured the unique flavor of the region by preserving every distinctive localism.
examples.zh: 作者通过保留每一个独特的方言词汇，捕捉到了该地区的独特风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 localism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [逻]反事实的( 指在不同条件下有可能发生但违反现存事实的)
lemmas.def_en: going counter to the facts (usually as a hypothesis)

examples.en: Historians love engaging in counterfactual speculation about what if the empire had never fallen.
examples.zh: 历史学家喜欢进行反事实推测，假设那个帝国从未灭亡会怎样。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterfactual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a manual of black magic (for invoking spirits and demons)

examples.en: The ancient grimoire was bound in dark leather and filled with cryptic magic rituals.
examples.zh: 那本古老的魔法书用深色皮革装订，里面记载着晦涩的魔法仪式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grimoire 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棘鳍类热带淡水鱼,丽鱼科鱼
lemmas.def_en: freshwater fishes of tropical America and Africa and Asia similar to American sunfishes; some are food fishes; many small ones are popular in aquariums

examples.en: The colorful African cichlid defended its rocky territory aggressively against other aquarium fish.
examples.zh: 这条色彩斑斓的非洲丽鱼科鱼在水族箱中极力保卫自己的岩石领地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cichlid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cover up with a liquid correction fluid

examples.en: Please whiteout the incorrect serial number before photocopying the final official document.
examples.zh: 复印最终官方文件之前，请用涂改液遮盖错误的序列号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whiteout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无才智的, 不机敏的, 愚蠢的, 糊涂的, 无知的
lemmas.def_en: (of especially persons) lacking sense or understanding or judgment

examples.en: It was completely witless of him to leave his house keys inside the car.
examples.zh: 他把房门钥匙忘在车里，真是太糊涂了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 witless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Immanuel Kant or his philosophy

examples.en: As a dedicated Kantian, she firmly argued that moral duties are absolute and universal.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的康德主义者，她坚定地认为道德责任是绝对且普遍适用的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kantian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: room where work is done

examples.en: Natural light flooded the spacious workroom where the fashion designer sketched new patterns.
examples.zh: 自然光洒满了宽敞的工作室，时装设计师正在那里绘制新图样。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 workroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having five units or components

examples.en: The company reported a fivefold increase in online sales during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 该公司报告称，假日期间线上销售额增长了五倍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fivefold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可亵渎的, 不可侵犯的, 神圣的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being transgressed or dishonored

examples.en: Every citizen has an inviolable right to personal freedom and fair trial.
examples.zh: 每个公民都享有不可侵犯的人身自由和公正审判权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inviolable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=nudist)天体运动者, 裸体主义者(指认为裸体有益身心的人)
lemmas.def_en: a person who practices nudity for reasons of health or religion

examples.en: The secluded coastal bay is popular among local naturists during the summer.
examples.zh: 在夏季，这个隐蔽的海岸海湾深受当地裸体主义者的欢迎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 naturist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flat stone for sharpening edged tools or knives

examples.en: He carefully sharpened the dull kitchen knife on a wet whetstone.
examples.zh: 他在一块湿润的磨石上仔细打磨那把变钝的菜刀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whetstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the stationary support in a machine or power tool that supports and drives a revolving part (as a chuck or the spindle on a lathe)

examples.en: The lathe's heavy headstock houses the motor that drives the main spindle.
examples.zh: 车床沉重的机头座内装有驱动主轴的电机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headstock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赫姆（男子名, 等于Herman）；头像方碑；上有赫耳墨斯头像的方形石柱界碑
lemmas.def_en: a statue consisting of a squared stone pillar with a carved head (usually a bearded Hermes) on top; used in ancient Greece as a boundary marker or signpost

examples.en: An ancient marble herm stood near the entrance of the Greek villa.
examples.zh: 一座古老的生殖神头像方碑伫立在希腊别墅的入口旁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal condition in which cerebrospinal fluid collects in the ventricles of the brain; in infants it can cause abnormally rapid growth of the head and bulging fontanelles and a small face; in adults the symptoms are primarily neurological

examples.en: Early surgical intervention is critical to treat severe infant hydrocephalus effectively.
examples.zh: 早期手术干预对有效治疗婴儿严重脑积水至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrocephalus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 免疫系统受损伤[削弱]的
lemmas.def_en: unable to develop a normal immune response usually because of malnutrition or immunodeficiency or immunosuppressive therapy

examples.en: Vaccines are especially vital for shielding immunocompromised patients from severe bacterial infections.
examples.zh: 疫苗对于保护免疫系统受损的患者免受严重细菌感染尤为重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immunocompromised 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适应的, 适应不良的, 不利于适应的, 显示不适应的
lemmas.def_en: showing faulty adaptation

examples.en: Ignoring chronic stress is a maladaptive response that harms long-term mental health.
examples.zh: 无视慢性压力是一种有害长期心理健康的适应不良行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maladaptive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the property of not existing for indefinitely long durations

examples.en: The falling cherry blossoms reminded the poet of life's fragile impermanence.
examples.zh: 飘落的樱花让诗人联想到了生命脆弱的无常。

lemmas.def_en: not permanent; not lasting; - James Thurber

examples.en: Buddhism often reminds practitioners that human life is fragile and thoroughly impermanent.
examples.zh: 佛教常提醒信徒，人生既脆弱又完全是暂时无常的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impermanence 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trap for catching mice

examples.en: He placed a wooden mousetrap behind the kitchen refrigerator with cheese.
examples.zh: 他在厨房冰箱后面放了一个夹着奶酪的木制捕鼠器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mousetrap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: designating a verb that does not require or cannot take a direct object

examples.en: The teacher explained that the verb 'arrive' is completely intransitive here.
examples.zh: 老师解释说，动词“arrive”在这里完全是不及物的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intransitive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cellulose ester obtained by treating cellulose with caustic soda

examples.en: This lightweight summer dress is crafted from a soft viscose fabric blend.
examples.zh: 这件轻便的夏装是由柔软的粘胶混纺面料制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viscose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 土地之所有, 私有地, 领地
lemmas.def_en: extensive landed property (especially in the country) retained by the owner for his own use

examples.en: The medieval lord rode across his vast demesne to inspect farmlands.
examples.zh: 中世纪的领主骑马穿过他广袤的领地以视察农田。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demesne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bulky greyish-brown eagle with a short wedge-shaped white tail; of Europe and Greenland

examples.en: A majestic sea ern circled high above the rocky northern cliffs.
examples.zh: 一只雄伟的白尾海雕在北部多岩石的悬崖上空盘旋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lowest atmospheric layer; from 4 to 11 miles high (depending on latitude)

examples.en: Nearly all clouds and storm systems develop within the earth's troposphere.
examples.zh: 几乎所有的云层和风暴系统都形成于地球的对流层内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troposphere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 主教之职, 主教区, 主教
lemmas.def_en: the term of office of a bishop

examples.en: During his long episcopate, the bishop funded several new local charity programs.
examples.zh: 在他长期的主教任期内，该主教资助了几个新的地方慈善项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 episcopate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: loss of emotional control often resulting in emotional collapse

examples.en: Rumors of massive debt sent the tech company's stock into a tailspin.
examples.zh: 巨额债务的谣言使这家科技公司的股价陷入急速下跌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailspin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small sunfishes of the genus Pomoxis of central United States rivers

examples.en: The young boy caught a large black crappie from the shallow lake.
examples.zh: 小男孩从浅水湖中钓起了一条巨大的黑刺盖太阳鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crappie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: primitive long-bodied carnivorous freshwater fish with a very long dorsal fin; found in sluggish waters of North America

examples.en: The fisherman caught a small spiny dogfish while trawling the harbor waters.
examples.zh: 渔夫在港口水域拖网捕鱼时抓到了一条小型角鲨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dogfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 曲线美的, 肉体美的
lemmas.def_en: (of a woman's body) having a large bosom and pleasing curves

examples.en: The model wore an elegant red dress that flattered her curvaceous figure.
examples.zh: 这位模特穿了一件展现她曼妙曲线身材的优雅红裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 curvaceous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Islam) the will of Allah

examples.en: Meeting her at the train station felt like pure kismet to him.
examples.zh: 在火车站遇见她，对他而言完全是命中注定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kismet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who lends money or gives credit in business matters

examples.en: The mechanic provided a free loaner car while mine was being repaired.
examples.zh: 修车期间，修理工免费提供了一辆代步车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loaner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 看出, 望见, 发现
lemmas.def_en: catch sight of

examples.en: From the hill, the scout could espy enemy troops moving southward.
examples.zh: 侦察兵从小山上望见敌军正在向南移动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 espy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unrestrained by convention or morality

examples.en: He squandered his entire family fortune through years of dissolute living.
examples.zh: 多年的放荡生活让他挥霍光了全副家产。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissolute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: make small marks into the surface of

examples.en: The archer carefully nocked an arrow before drawing back the heavy bowstring.
examples.zh: 弓箭手小心地将箭搭在弦上，然后拉紧了沉重的弓弦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗蓝布, 劳动布, 粗蓝布裤子, 工作服
lemmas.def_en: a coarse durable twill-weave cotton fabric

examples.en: The carpenter wore durable dungarees while working on the rough construction site.
examples.zh: 木匠在粗糙的建筑工地上干活时穿着耐磨的粗蓝布工装裤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dungaree 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 为恶者, 做坏事的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who sins (without repenting)

examples.en: The local authorities vowed to track down every evildoer involved in the fraud.
examples.zh: 当地政府誓要追查出参与这起诈骗案的每一个作恶者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evildoer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 车辆荷载, 货车的最低载重量
lemmas.def_en: a gathering of passengers sufficient to fill an automobile

examples.en: The freight train delivered a full carload of fresh timber to the sawmill.
examples.zh: 货运列车将整整一车皮的新鲜木材运到了锯木厂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carload 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (rare) worship that admits or tolerates all gods

examples.en: His poetry reflects a deep pantheism, finding the divine in every aspect of nature.
examples.zh: 他的诗作反映出深刻的泛神论，在自然的各处探寻神性。

lemmas.def_zh: 泛神论的, 泛神论者的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to pantheism
of or relating to pantheism

examples.en: His poetry reflects a pantheist worldview that finds divinity in nature.
examples.zh: 他的诗歌反映出一种在自然中发现神性的泛神论世界观。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pantheism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a religious person who goes to church regularly

examples.en: As a devout churchgoer, she never missed Sunday service for twenty years.
examples.zh: 作为一名虔诚的礼拜者，她二十年来从未缺席过周日礼拜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churchgoer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large mass of intrusive igneous rock believed to have solidified deep within the earth

examples.en: Geologists studied the granitic pluton exposed by millions of years of erosion.
examples.zh: 地质学家研究了因数百万年侵蚀而裸露出来的花岗岩深成岩体。

lemmas.def_en: of igneous rock that has solidified beneath the earth's surface; granite or diorite or gabbro

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pluton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: horse of a light yellowish dun color with dark mane and tail

examples.en: The tracker wore a traditional jacket made of soft, tanned buckskin.
examples.zh: 这位追踪者穿着一件由柔软的鞣制鹿皮制成的传统夹克。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buckskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 剥皮, 擦破皮肤, 严厉的责难
lemmas.def_en: express strong disapproval of

examples.en: The movie critic used his column to excoriate the director's latest film.
examples.zh: 这位影评人在专栏中严厉抨击了该导演的最新电影。

lemmas.def_zh: 表皮脱落, 严厉责难, 苛责
lemmas.def_en: an abraded area where the skin is torn or worn off

family_guide.root_logic: 以 excoriate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hold spellbound

examples.en: The soprano's mesmerizing performance managed to enrapture the entire auditorium.
examples.zh: 女高音迷人的表演彻底征服了全场观众，令人如痴如醉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enrapture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: eliminate the polarization of

examples.en: Specialized optical filters can depolarize incoming laser light effectively for the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验中，专用的光学滤光片能有效使入射激光去偏振。

lemmas.def_en: a loss of polarity or polarization

family_guide.root_logic: 以 depolarize 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 象形文字, 古代石壁画, 统计图表
lemmas.def_en: a graphic character used in picture writing

examples.en: Ancient hunters carved a pictograph of a running bison onto the cave wall.
examples.zh: 古代猎人在洞穴墙壁上雕刻了一幅野牛奔跑的象形岩画。

lemmas.def_zh: 象形文字的, 统计图表的
lemmas.def_en: consisting of or characterized by the use of pictographs

examples.en: a pictographic script
pictographic stage in the development of writing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pictograph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 球状体, 回转椭球体
lemmas.def_en: a shape that is generated by rotating an ellipse around one of its axes

examples.en: Because of its axial rotation, Earth is technically an oblate spheroid.
examples.zh: 由于自身自转，地球在严格意义上是一个扁球体。

lemmas.def_zh: 球状的, 扁球体的, 椭球体的
lemmas.def_en: having the nature or shape of an ellipsoid

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spheroid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: phenomena that appear to contradict physical laws and suggest the possibility of causation by mental processes

examples.en: Her controversial research in parapsychology focused on telepathy and precognition.
examples.zh: 她在心灵学领域的争议性研究主要集中于心灵感应和预知能力。

lemmas.def_en: someone who studies the evidence for such psychological phenomena as psychokinesis and telepathy and clairvoyance
beyond normal physical explanation

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parapsychology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to the phylum Brachiopoda

examples.en: The paleontologist found a well-preserved brachiopod fossil embedded in the shale.
examples.zh: 古生物学家在页岩中发现了一块保存完好的腕足动物化石。

lemmas.def_en: marine animal with bivalve shell having a pair of arms bearing tentacles for capturing food; found worldwide

examples.en: The paleontologist found a well-preserved brachiopod fossil embedded in the shale.
examples.zh: 古生物学家在页岩中发现了一块保存完好的腕足动物化石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brachiopod 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: direct opposite

examples.en: Her peaceful countryside home was the exact antipode of her chaotic city life.
examples.zh: 她宁静的乡村住宅与她混乱的城市生活形成了鲜明对比。

lemmas.def_en: relating to the antipodes or situated at opposite sides of the earth

examples.en: They decided to spend their winter holidays exploring sunny Antipodean landscapes.
examples.zh: 他们决定在阳光明媚的大洋洲度过寒假，探索那里的美景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antipode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous plants of the genus Gladiolus native chiefly to tropical and South Africa having sword-shaped leaves and one-sided spikes of brightly colored funnel-shaped flowers; widely cultivated

examples.en: She cut a tall pink gladiolus from the garden to display in the vase.
examples.zh: 她从花园里剪下一株高挺的粉色唐菖蒲插在花瓶里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gladiolus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who believes in organic evolution

examples.en: The evolutionist presented compelling fossil evidence supporting the theory of natural selection.
examples.zh: 这位进化论者展示了支持自然选择理论的有力化石证据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evolutionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the position of mayor

examples.en: Her successful mayoralty transformed the city into a bustling cultural and tech hub.
examples.zh: 她在市长任期内的卓越治理将这座城市变成了繁华的文化与科技中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mayoralty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a path along a canal or river used by animals towing boats

examples.en: We enjoyed a peaceful morning walk along the canal towpath watching ducks drift by.
examples.zh: 我们清晨在运河纤道上惬意漫步，看着鸭子从水面划过。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 towpath 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 拥立国王者, 有权支配要职的任命者
lemmas.def_en: English statesman; during the War of the Roses he fought first for the house of York and secured the throne for Edward IV and then changed sides to fight for the house of Lancaster and secured the throne for Henry VI (1428-1471)

examples.en: The influential senator acted as a kingmaker during the fiercely contested party primary.
examples.zh: 这位有影响力的参议员在竞争激烈的党内初选中扮演了造王者角色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kingmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who is considered to be dangerously seductive

examples.en: In ancient mythology, the siren was portrayed as a dangerous temptress luring sailors.
examples.zh: 在古代神话中，塞壬被描绘成引诱水手走向毁灭的危险诱惑者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 temptress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: without fat or fat solids

examples.en: He ordered an iced latte made with nonfat milk to cut down calories.
examples.zh: 他点了一杯用脱脂牛奶制作的冰拿铁以减少热量摄入。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nonfat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not having legs

examples.en: The glass lizard is actually a legless reptile often mistaken for a snake.
examples.zh: 帝王蛇蜥实际上是一种经常被误认为蛇的无腿爬行动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 legless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 慷慨的赠与, 慷慨赠与物, 慷慨的赏钱
lemmas.def_en: a gift or money given (as for service or out of benevolence); usually given ostentatiously

examples.en: The local library was built entirely through the largesse of a wealthy donor.
examples.zh: 这座当地图书馆完全依靠一位富有捐赠者的慷慨解囊而建。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 largesse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 大分子的, 巨分子的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or consisting of or characterized by macromolecules

examples.en: The lab focuses on synthesizing macromolecular structures for novel drug delivery systems.
examples.zh: 该实验室专注于合成用于新型药物输送系统的大分子结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macromolecular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the conveyances (or cars) in a telpherage

examples.en: An electric telfer transported heavy cargo boxes across the industrial factory floor smoothly.
examples.zh: 一台电动悬挂起重机平稳地在工业厂房内搬运沉重的货箱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 telfer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: important for human and animal food; growth habit and stem form similar to Indian corn but having sawtooth-edged leaves

examples.en: The author condemned the use of the word kaffir as deeply offensive hate speech.
examples.zh: 作者谴责使用该词属于具有极强冒犯性的仇恨言论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kaffir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能熄灭的, 不能遏制的, 止不住的
lemmas.def_en: impossible to quench

examples.en: Her unquenchable thirst for knowledge drove her to read every book in the library.
examples.zh: 她对知识不可遏制的渴求驱使她读遍了图书馆里的每一本书。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unquenchable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a little; a piece

examples.en: The comedian's self-deprecating schtick had the entire audience laughing within minutes.
examples.zh: 这位喜剧演员自嘲式的招牌套路在几分钟内就逗乐了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schtick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一符多音(现象), 复音现象, 复调音乐
lemmas.def_en: music arranged in parts for several voices or instruments

examples.en: The choir delivered a mesmerizing performance showcasing the complex polyphony of Renaissance music.
examples.zh: 合唱团带来了迷人的演出，展现了文艺复兴音乐复杂的复调特色。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polyphony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 领带, 围巾, 三角绷带
lemmas.def_en: neckwear worn in a slipknot with long ends overlapping vertically in front

examples.en: He wore a silk cravat tucked neatly inside his tailored vintage velvet jacket.
examples.zh: 他戴着一条整齐塞在剪裁考究的复古丝绒夹克里的丝绸领巾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cravat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bar of sand

examples.en: The fishing boat accidentally ran aground on a hidden sandbar near the bay.
examples.zh: 这艘渔船在海湾附近的一处隐蔽沙洲上意外搁浅了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sandbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结婚前的, 婚礼前的
lemmas.def_en: relating to events before a marriage

examples.en: The couple decided to sign a prenuptial agreement before their lavish autumn wedding.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇决定在奢华的秋季婚礼前签署一份婚前协议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prenuptial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 天文钟, 航海用的精密时计, 精密的时钟
lemmas.def_en: an accurate clock (especially used in navigation)

examples.en: Sailors relied on the marine chronometer to calculate longitude accurately across open oceans.
examples.zh: 水手们依靠航海精密时计在大洋上精确测算经度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chronometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （运送滑雪者或游客上, 下上的）升降机
lemmas.def_en: a ski lift on which riders (skiers or sightseers) are seated and carried up or down a mountainside; seats are hung from an endless overhead cable

examples.en: We rode the chairlift to the mountain peak to admire the snowy landscape.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐缆车登上山顶，俯瞰壮丽的雪景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chairlift 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plastic made from cellulose (or a derivative of cellulose)

examples.en: Researchers developed a new biodegradable film using sustainable cellulosic fibers from plant waste.
examples.zh: 研究人员利用植物废料中的可持续纤维素纤维开发出新型可降解薄膜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cellulosic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 蒜泥蛋黄酱(一种用蒜泥、蛋黄、橄榄油和柠檬汁配制的调味汁)
lemmas.def_en: garlic mayonnaise

examples.en: The chef served crispy golden calamari alongside a ramekin of homemade garlic aioli.
examples.zh: 主厨端上了金黄酥脆的鱿鱼圈，并配有一小碗自制蒜泥蛋黄酱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aioli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow elongated opening or fissure between two symmetrical parts

examples.en: The surgeon carefully examined the rima glottidis to check for any vocal obstruction.
examples.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了声门裂，以确认是否存在声带阻塞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rima 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (mathematics) the number of elements in a set or group (considered as a property of that grouping)

examples.en: The database query failed because the column had an unexpectedly high data cardinality.
examples.zh: 数据库查询失败，原因是该列的数据基数异常之高。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cardinality 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the size of a book whose pages are made by folding a sheet of paper three times to form eight leaves

examples.en: The collector bought a rare octavo edition of Shakespeare's sonnets printed in 1609.
examples.zh: 这位收藏家购买了一本极其罕见的1609年版莎士比亚十四行诗八开本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 octavo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 候选人的地位, 候选人资格
lemmas.def_en: the campaign of a candidate to be elected

examples.en: She officially announced her candidature for the upcoming parliamentary elections yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她昨天下午正式宣布了参加即将举行的议会选举的候选人资格。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 candidature 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a portable loudspeaker with built-in microphone and amplifier

examples.en: The police officer raised his bullhorn and ordered the gathered crowd to disperse immediately.
examples.zh: 警察拿起手提扩音器，命令聚集的人群立即散开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullhorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 没有精神的, 灰心的, 心碎的
lemmas.def_en: full of sorrow

examples.en: He wandered the empty streets brokenhearted after his longtime partner ended their engagement.
examples.zh: 长期的伴侣解除婚约后，他心碎地漫步在空旷的街道上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brokenhearted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an arm

examples.en: The paramedic applied firm pressure to the patient's brachial artery to stop the bleeding.
examples.zh: 急救人员紧紧按住患者的肱动脉以阻止出血。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brachial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flighty scatterbrained simpleton

examples.en: Troops rapidly secured the airhead to allow transport planes to deliver critical supplies.
examples.zh: 部队迅速控制了空降场，以便运输机能够运送关键物资。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inflammatory swelling or sore

examples.en: Extreme cold exposure caused a painful blain to form on his exposed finger joint.
examples.zh: 极度受冻导致他暴露的手指关节上形成了一个疼痛的水疱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无空气的, 不通风的
lemmas.def_en: lacking fresh air

examples.en: The miners struggled to breathe in the dark, airless tunnel deep underground.
examples.zh: 矿工们在地下深处黑暗且不通风的隧道里艰难地呼吸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 airless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a native or inhabitant of Alsace

examples.en: The Alsatian spoke French with a distinct accent inherited from generations in the borderlands.
examples.zh: 这位阿尔萨斯人说着带有边境地区世代流传的独特口音的法语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alsatian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bristlelike process near the tip of the antenna of certain flies

examples.en: The researcher examined the tiny feather-like arista on the fruit fly's antenna.
examples.zh: 研究人员仔细观察了果蝇触角上微小的羽毛状端刺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arista 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雇主一年一次款待雇工的宴席,<俚>快乐的宴会
lemmas.def_en: a game in which numbered balls are drawn at random and players cover the corresponding numbers on their cards

examples.en: The factory owner hosted a lavish annual beano for all his hardworking employees.
examples.zh: 工厂老板为所有辛勤工作的员工举办了一年一度的丰盛宴席。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beano 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small tree with pear-shaped fruit whose oil is used in perfumery; Italy

examples.en: Earl Grey tea gets its distinctive citrus fragrance from the oil of the bergamot fruit.
examples.zh: 伯爵茶独特的柑橘清香来自香柠檬果实的提取油。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bergamot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an orange-yellow pigment in the bile that forms as a product of hemoglobin; excess amounts in the blood produce the yellow appearance observed in jaundice

examples.en: A simple blood test showed elevated bilirubin levels, indicating a potential liver malfunction.
examples.zh: 简单的血液检测显示胆红素水平偏高，表明可能存在肝功能障碍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bilirubin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: two crossed bones (or a representation of two crossed bones) used as a symbol danger or death

examples.en: The pirate flag fluttered in the salty wind, displaying a white skull and crossbones.
examples.zh: 海盗旗在带着咸味的微风中飘扬，上面印着白色的骷髅和交叉骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crossbones 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （海员常吃的）炖杂烩（肉和蔬菜和饼干等混成的炖菜）
lemmas.def_en: a stew of meat and vegetables and hardtack that is eaten by sailors

examples.en: We warmed ourselves by the fire with a hearty bowl of traditional beef scouse.
examples.zh: 我们在火炉旁喝着一碗热气腾腾的传统牛肉杂烩取暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sloping mass of loose rocks at the base of a cliff

examples.en: Loose scree slipped under our hiking boots as we carefully scrambled down the steep slope.
examples.zh: 当我们小心翼翼地从陡坡上往下爬时，松散的岩屑在登山靴下滑动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scree 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to Aristotle or his philosophy

examples.en: His peripatetic career as a documentary filmmaker took him to over fifty different countries.
examples.zh: 作为一名纪录片导演，他四处奔波的职业生涯让他走遍了五十多个国家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peripatetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 冷藏库, 冰箱, 冷冻室
lemmas.def_en: white goods in which food can be stored at low temperatures

examples.en: Before modern refrigeration existed, families kept dairy products cold in a wooden icebox.
examples.zh: 在现代制冷设备出现之前，家庭通常将乳制品存放在木制冰箱中保鲜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icebox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally high blood sugar usually associated with diabetes

examples.en: Frequent thirst and extreme fatigue are common early symptoms of uncontrolled hyperglycemia.
examples.zh: 频繁口渴和极度疲劳是未经控制的高血糖症的常见早期症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperglycemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 简陋小屋, 杂物间, 家畜小屋
lemmas.def_en: small crude shelter used as a dwelling

examples.en: The impoverished family lived in a tiny mud hovel at the edge of town.
examples.zh: 这户赤贫的家庭住在城镇边缘的一座微小的泥质简陋小屋里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hovel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (folklore) a small grotesque supernatural creature that makes trouble for human beings

examples.en: In folklore, a mischievous hobgoblin played harmless pranks on lazy villagers at night.
examples.zh: 在民间传说中，爱恶作剧的妖怪总在夜间捉弄懒惰的村民。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hobgoblin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: feeding only on plants

examples.en: The giant herbivorous dinosaur consumed hundreds of pounds of leaves and fern fronds daily.
examples.zh: 这种巨大的食草恐龙每天要吃掉数百磅的树叶和蕨类植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 herbivorous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: collapse caused by exposure to excessive heat

examples.en: He suffered from heatstroke after running a marathon under the scorching midday sun.
examples.zh: 在正午灼热的阳光下跑完马拉松后，他中暑了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 heatstroke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a subordinate position

examples.en: In ancient times, poetry was often viewed as a humble handmaiden to religion.
examples.zh: 在古代，诗歌常被视作宗教的卑微侍女。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handmaiden 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who collects taxes for the government

examples.en: You can delay filing, but the taxman will eventually demand his money.
examples.zh: 你可以拖延申报，但税务人员最终还是会找你要钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taxman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a storm during which hail falls

examples.en: A sudden summer hailstorm severely damaged several parked cars along the street.
examples.zh: 一场突如其来的夏季雹暴严重砸坏了沿街停放的几辆汽车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hailstorm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wind blowing in the same direction as the path of a ship or aircraft

examples.en: The airplane arrived ahead of schedule thanks to a strong and steady tailwind.
examples.zh: 多亏了一阵强劲而稳定的顺风，飞机提前抵达了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailwind 为核心的派生词族。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sulcus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: below the dura mater but above the arachnoid membrane of the meninges

examples.en: The patient required emergency surgery to treat a severe subdural hematoma.
examples.zh: 该患者需要进行急诊手术以治疗严重的硬膜下血肿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subdural 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能以语言表达地, 无法形容地
lemmas.def_en: to an inexpressible degree

examples.en: She felt unspeakably relieved after hearing the doctor's reassuring test results.
examples.zh: 听到医生令人宽慰的检查结果后，她感到无法形容的轻松。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unspeakably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a car smaller than a compact car

examples.en: Renting an affordable subcompact made parking in the crowded city easy.
examples.zh: 租用一辆价格实惠的超小型汽车让在拥挤的城市停车变得容易。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subcompact 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dome-shaped shrine erected by Buddhists

examples.en: Devout pilgrims walked solemnly around the ancient Buddhist stupa in prayer.
examples.zh: 虔诚的朝圣者庄严地绕着古老的佛塔祈祷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stupa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous showy orchids of the genus Vanda having many large flowers in loose racemes

examples.en: The rare blue vanda orchid blossomed spectacularly inside the warm greenhouse.
examples.zh: 稀有的蓝色万带兰在温暖的温室里绚丽绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vanda 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 树墩似的, 多根茬的
lemmas.def_en: short and thick; as e.g. having short legs and heavy musculature

examples.en: The bulldog wagged its stumpy tail excitedly whenever someone opened the door.
examples.zh: 每当有人开门时，斗牛犬都会兴奋地摇晃它那短粗的尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stumpy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 共鸣板, 响板; 音板
lemmas.def_en: (music) resonator consisting of a thin board whose vibrations reinforce the sound of the instrument

examples.en: The luthier carefully selected aged spruce wood to build the violin's new soundboard.
examples.zh: 制琴师精心挑选陈年云杉木来制作小提琴的新音板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soundboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 浑身湿透的, 多雨的, 假情假义的
lemmas.def_en: wet through and through; thoroughly wet

examples.en: He usually avoids romantic comedies because he finds the storylines far too soppy.
examples.zh: 他通常不看浪漫喜剧，因为他觉得那些情节太矫揉造作了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 soppy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood that is easy to saw (from conifers such as pine or fir)

examples.en: Pine is a common softwood used extensively in modern furniture making and construction.
examples.zh: 松木是一种常见的软木材，广泛用于现代家具制造和建筑中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 softwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fatty red flesh of salmon of Pacific coast and rivers

examples.en: Thousands of wild sockeye salmon swim upstream each autumn to reach their spawning grounds.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，成千上万的野生红大马哈鱼逆流而上前往产卵地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sockeye 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the fourth of the seven canonical hours; about noon

examples.en: The monks gathered quietly in the chapel at noon to recite the sext.
examples.zh: 僧侣们正午时分在小教堂静静集合，诵念第六时祷告。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sext 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ritual suicide by self-disembowelment on a sword; practiced by samurai in the traditional Japanese society

examples.en: Defeated samurai sometimes chose to commit seppuku rather than face the dishonor of capture.
examples.zh: 战败的武士有时会选择切腹自杀，而不愿面对被俘的耻辱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seppuku 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of schizophrenia

examples.en: His schizoid personality made it difficult for him to form close emotional bonds.
examples.zh: 他类精神分裂的人格特质使他很难建立亲密的情感纽带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schizoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圣骨匣, 遗骨匣, 圣物箱
lemmas.def_en: a container where religious relics are stored or displayed (especially relics of saints)

examples.en: The medieval church displayed a gilded reliquary containing the saint's sacred bone fragments.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪教堂展示了一个镀金圣骨匣，里面存有圣人的圣骨碎片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reliquary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the theory of reductionism

examples.en: Critics argued that his reductionist approach oversimplified the complex psychological issues involved.
examples.zh: 批评人士认为，他的还原论方法把涉及的复杂心理问题过于简单化了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reductionist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an area of open or forested country

examples.en: They enjoyed a peaceful weekend hiking through the ancient oak trees of the weald.
examples.zh: 他们享受了一个平静的周末，徒步穿过了林地中古老的橡树林。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weald 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: multiple collisions of vehicles

examples.en: Heavy morning fog caused a massive twenty-car pileup on the busy interstate highway.
examples.zh: 早晨的浓雾导致繁忙的州际公路上发生了一起20车连环相撞事故。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pileup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an edging of small loops, as on lace or ribbon

examples.en: She stitched a delicate picot edge along the border of the baby's blanket.
examples.zh: 她在婴儿毯子的边缘缝制了一圈精致的小环花边。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 picot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wealth regarded as an evil influence

examples.en: He abandoned his artistic dreams to pursue the relentless worship of mammon on Wall Street.
examples.zh: 他放弃了自己的艺术梦想，去华尔街无休止地追逐财富。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mammon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an island of central Hawaii; a pineapple-growing area

examples.en: We sat out on the screened lanai every evening to enjoy the tropical breeze.
examples.zh: 每天傍晚我们都坐在装有纱窗的凉台上，享受着热带的微风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lanai 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 咭咭呱呱说个不停的人, 多嘴的人
lemmas.def_en: a person who causes trouble by speaking indiscreetly

examples.en: Nobody at the party wanted to talk to that obnoxious loudmouth at the bar.
examples.zh: 派对上没人想理会吧台旁那个令人讨厌的大嘴巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loudmouth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （杂志的）中间插页, 裸体照片插页
lemmas.def_en: a magazine center spread; especially a foldout of a large photograph or map or other feature

examples.en: The magazine's anniversary issue featured an elaborate glossy centerfold of the scenic landscape.
examples.zh: 该杂志的周年纪念刊附有一张精美的高光风景拉页插图。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 centerfold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 二, 一对, 二元一位
lemmas.def_en: two items of the same kind

examples.en: The therapist observed the subtle nonverbal communication between the mother-infant dyad during play.
examples.zh: 治疗师在母婴二人玩耍时观察了他们之间微妙的非语言交流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dyad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fine-grained unstratified accumulation of clay and silt deposited by the wind

examples.en: Fertile farmland across the region is covered by a thick layer of windblown loess.
examples.zh: 该地区肥沃的农田上覆盖着一层厚厚的风积黄土。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loess 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a microscopic network of actin filaments and microtubules in the cytoplasm of many living cells that gives the cell shape and coherence

examples.en: The internal cytoskeleton provides essential structural support to help the animal cell maintain its shape.
examples.zh: 内部的细胞骨架提供了必要的结构支撑，帮助动物细胞保持形状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytoskeleton 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (以舌或唇刺激女性生殖器的行为)舔阴(亦作cunnilinctus)
lemmas.def_en: oral stimulation of the vulva or clitoris

examples.en: The comprehensive sex education manual discussed cunnilingus openly as a normal sexual practice.
examples.zh: 这本全面的性教育手册公开探讨了舔阴，将其视为一种正常的性行为。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cunnilingus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 时髦女服商店, 时髦女服商/女设计师
lemmas.def_en: someone who designs clothing

examples.en: The renowned Parisian couturier presented her latest haute couture collection during fashion week.
examples.zh: 这位著名的巴黎高级时装设计师在时装周期间展示了她的最新高定系列。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 couturier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 洗脸台, 五斗橱, 便桶
lemmas.def_en: a plumbing fixture for defecation and urination

examples.en: An antique wooden commode stood gracefully in the corner of the master bedroom.
examples.zh: 一个仿古木制五斗橱优雅地立在主卧室的角落里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who dresses in a trendy fashionable way

examples.en: They opened an excessively chichi cafe that caters exclusively to wealthy social media influencers.
examples.zh: 他们开了一家极其时髦浮夸的咖啡馆，专门迎合富有的社交媒体网红。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chichi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Carthusian monastery

examples.en: Visitors were stunned by the serene courtyards of the historic charterhouse near the hills.
examples.zh: 游客们被山丘附近那座历史悠久的卡尔特修道院中宁静的庭院所震撼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 charterhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a deep somewhat purplish blue color similar to that of a clear October sky

examples.en: The artist captured the calm sea beneath a vast cerulean sky.
examples.zh: 画家捕捉到了广阔蔚蓝天空下平静的大海。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cerulean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: local names for a cowboy (`vaquero' is used especially in southwestern and central Texas and `buckaroo' is used especially in California)

examples.en: The young buckaroo mounted his wild horse and rode across the dusty ranch.
examples.zh: 年轻的牛仔骑上野马，飞奔穿过尘土飞扬的牧场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buckaroo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 流出物, 流出, 消逝
lemmas.def_en: the process of flowing out

examples.en: The sudden efflux of industrial waste quickly contaminated the pristine mountain stream.
examples.zh: 工业废物的突然流出迅速污染了原始的山涧小溪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 efflux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 颊的, 口的, 口腔的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or toward the cheek

examples.en: The dentist carefully inserted a cotton roll into the patient's buccal cavity.
examples.zh: 牙医小心地将棉条塞入患者的口腔颊侧部位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 buccal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a vine of the genus Bryonia having large leaves and small flowers and yielding acrid juice with emetic and purgative properties

examples.en: Wild bryony clung tightly to the old stone wall along the lane.
examples.zh: 野生的泻根植物紧紧攀附在小巷古老的石墙上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bryony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a place where bricks are made and sold

examples.en: He worked long, exhausting shifts at the local brickyard every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，他都在当地的砖厂值极其繁重的长班。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brickyard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small pork sausage

examples.en: We grilled seasoned bratwurst over charcoal during the lively backyard party.
examples.zh: 在热闹的后院聚会中，我们在木炭上烤制了风味德国香肠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bratwurst 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 变弯曲, 屈服；使弯曲, 使屈服
lemmas.def_en: form a curve

examples.en: The strong gust of wind caused the slender birch tree to bend sharply.
examples.zh: 强烈的阵风使纤细的白桦树大幅度弯曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bended 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阿卡迪亚的；田园牧歌式的, 田园的
lemmas.def_en: (used with regard to idealized country life) idyllically rustic

examples.en: They spent a peaceful summer retreat in an idyllic, arcadian mountain valley.
examples.zh: 他们在田园牧歌般恬静的山谷中度过了一个祥和的避暑假。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arcadian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of nerves and nerve impulses; conveying sensory information from the sense organs to the CNS

examples.en: Sensory receptors send vital signals to the brain through afferent nerve fibers.
examples.zh: 感觉感受器通过传入神经纤维向大脑发送重要信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 afferent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: noisy like the sound of a bee

examples.en: The tiny town was abuzz with wild rumors after the unexpected robbery.
examples.zh: 在发生意外抢劫案后，整个小镇充斥着各种流言蜚语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abuzz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在地面上的, 活着的
lemmas.def_en: on or above the surface of the ground

examples.en: The workers installed an aboveground swimming pool right behind the patio area.
examples.zh: 工人们在庭院正后方安装了一个地上游泳池。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aboveground 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 惊人(或重要)新闻的透露, (说话、闲话等的)大量, 过多, 斥责
lemmas.def_en: an outpouring of gossip

examples.en: The angry customer gave the careless manager an earful about the delay.
examples.zh: 愤怒的顾客就延误一事将粗心的经理狠狠训斥了一顿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: perceptible by the senses or intellect

examples.en: There was no discernable difference between the genuine painting and the fake.
examples.zh: 真画与赝品之间没有任何可辨别的差异。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 discernable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贪口福的, 享乐主义的
lemmas.def_en: of Epicurus or epicureanism

examples.en: The lavish restaurant offered guests a truly exceptional and refined epicurean experience.
examples.zh: 这家奢华的餐厅为客人们提供了真正非凡而精致的享乐美食体验。

lemmas.def_zh: 美食家, 讲究饮食的人
lemmas.def_en: a person devoted to refined sensuous enjoyment (especially good food and drink)

examples.en: As a true epicure, she could identify every subtle spice in the sauce.
examples.zh: 作为一位真正的美食家，她能分辨出酱汁中每一种微妙的香料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epicurean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unacceptable behavior (especially ludicrously false statements)

examples.en: I refuse to listen to any more of his ridiculous political guff.
examples.zh: 我拒绝再听他那些荒谬的政治胡话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a grass of the genus Agropyron

examples.en: She drank a fresh shot of green wheatgrass juice every single morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早晨都喝一小杯新鲜的青麦草汁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wheatgrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 转向, 报复, 转变
lemmas.def_en: a decision to reverse an earlier decision

examples.en: In a surprising turnabout, the leading candidate suddenly dropped out of politics.
examples.zh: 令人意外的是，领先的候选人突然转变立场退出了政坛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turnabout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a disorderly outburst or tumult

examples.en: The mix-up over luggage caused a major kerfuffle at the airport terminal.
examples.zh: 行李弄混在机场航站楼引发了一场大混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kerfuffle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reddish brown North American marmot

examples.en: A plump woodchuck was busily digging a deep burrow under the shed.
examples.zh: 一只肥胖的土拨鼠正忙着在工棚下挖一个深洞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodchuck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不公平的, 不公正的
lemmas.def_en: not equitable or fair

examples.en: The workers protested against the highly inequitable distribution of corporate profits.
examples.zh: 工人们抗议公司利润分配极度不公的现象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inequitable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 疑病患者, 疑病的, 季肋部的
lemmas.def_en: suffering from hypochondria

examples.en: His hypochondriac fears convinced him that every minor sneeze signaled pneumonia.
examples.zh: 他疑病症般的恐惧让他坚信每一次轻微的喷嚏都预示着肺炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypochondriac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (= hollandaise sauce)蛋黄奶油酸辣酱, 荷兰式的
lemmas.def_en: eggs and butter with lemon juice

examples.en: She generously drizzled warm hollandaise sauce over the freshly poached eggs.
examples.zh: 她将温热的荷兰蛋黄酱淋在新鲜的水波蛋上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hollandaise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [人名] 汉基; [地名] [南非共和国] 汉基
lemmas.def_en: a square piece of cloth used for wiping the eyes or nose or as a costume accessory

examples.en: They drove through Hankey to explore the scenic citrus orchards along the river.
examples.zh: 他们驱车穿过汉基镇，去探寻沿河风景优美的柑橘园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hankey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coarse jute fabric

examples.en: Workers loaded heavy gunny sacks filled with green coffee beans onto the truck.
examples.zh: 工人们把装满生咖啡豆的厚重麻袋搬上了卡车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garden having shrubs clipped or trimmed into decorative shapes especially of animals

examples.en: The palace garden is famous for its intricate topiary shaped like mythical creatures.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿花园以修剪成神话生物形状的精美灌木造型而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 topiary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生化]胰高血糖素,胰增血糖素
lemmas.def_en: a hormone secreted by the pancreas; stimulates increases in blood sugar levels in the blood (thus opposing the action of insulin)

examples.en: When your blood sugar levels drop too low, the pancreas naturally releases glucagon.
examples.zh: 当你的血糖水平降得过低时，胰腺会自然释放胰高血糖素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glucagon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雾号, 响而尖的声音
lemmas.def_en: a loud low warning signal that can be heard by fogbound ships

examples.en: Through the dense night mist, the distant foghorn warned ships away from rocks.
examples.zh: 透过浓重的夜雾，远处传来的雾号声警告船只远离礁石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foghorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a purine base found in DNA and RNA; pairs with cytosine

examples.en: In DNA molecules, guanine always forms chemical pairs with another base called cytosine.
examples.zh: 在DNA分子中，鸟嘌呤总是与另一种称为胞嘧啶的碱基配对。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guanine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fight with bare fists

examples.en: A heated argument outside the pub quickly escalated into an outright round of fisticuffs.
examples.zh: 酒吧外激烈的争吵很快升级为一场直接的互殴拳斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fisticuffs 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or demonstrating ferromagnetism

examples.en: Iron and nickel are well-known ferromagnetic materials that magnets attract with strong force.
examples.zh: 铁和镍是众所周知的铁磁性材料，会被磁铁强烈吸引。

lemmas.def_en: phenomenon exhibited by materials like iron (nickel or cobalt) that become magnetized in a magnetic field and retain their magnetism when the field is removed

examples.en: The lab experiment demonstrated how high temperatures can disrupt ferromagnetism in iron.
examples.zh: 该实验室实验展示了高温如何破坏铁的铁磁性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ferromagnetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (对野生动物、自然区、古迹和传统事物等的)保护主义者
lemmas.def_en: someone who advocates the preservation of historical sites or endangered species or natural areas

examples.en: The local preservationist fought tirelessly to stop developers from tearing down the historic theater.
examples.zh: 这位当地古迹保护者不知疲倦地奔走，阻止开发商拆除历史剧院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preservationist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: decoration consisting of an open pattern of interlacing ribs

examples.en: Delicate stone tracery decorated the soaring Gothic arched windows of the old cathedral.
examples.zh: 精致的石雕窗花格装点着老教堂高耸的哥特式拱窗。

lemmas.def_zh: n. 窗花格, 装饰线条

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tracery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extending or lying across; in a crosswise direction; at right angles to the long axis

examples.en: In geometry class, the teacher drew a transversal line cutting across two parallel lines.
examples.zh: 在几何课上，老师画了一条横截两条平行线的截线。

lemmas.def_en: in a transverse manner

examples.en: they were cut transversely

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transversal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cut a bevel on; shape to a bevel

examples.en: The carpenter used a special hand plane to chamfer the sharp edges of the tabletop.
examples.zh: 木匠用专门的刨子将桌板锋利的边缘削出倒角。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chamfer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 野营, 露营, 露营地
lemmas.def_en: temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers

examples.en: The soldiers made a hasty bivouac in the mountain pass before darkness fell completely.
examples.zh: 天彻底黑下来之前，士兵们在山口匆匆搭建了一个临时露营地。

lemmas.def_en: live in or as if in a tent

examples.en: The soldiers made a hasty bivouac in the mountain pass before darkness fell completely.
examples.zh: 天彻底黑下来之前，士兵们在山口匆匆搭建了一个临时露营地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bivouac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a number of fishes of the family Carangidae

examples.en: The fishermen hauled in a large net teeming with fresh, glittering scad.
examples.zh: 渔民们拉起一张大网，里面挤满了新鲜发亮的竹荚鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: disinclined to work or exertion

examples.en: On warm summer afternoons, the indolent cat simply slept under the porch for hours.
examples.zh: 在温暖的夏日午后，那只懒洋洋的猫就在门廊下一连睡上几个小时。

lemmas.def_en: in an indolent manner

examples.en: he lives indolently with his relatives

lemmas.def_en: inactivity resulting from a dislike of work

examples.en: A warm summer afternoon induced a feeling of pure, pleasant indolence.
examples.zh: 温暖的夏日午后让人产生一种纯粹而惬意的慵懒感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indolent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large hemispherical brass or copper percussion instrument with a drumhead that can be tuned by adjusting the tension on it

examples.en: The dramatic symphony concluded with a powerful roll from the timpani.
examples.zh: 激昂的交响乐在定音鼓强有力的滚奏中落下帷幕。

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓膜, 耳膜, 鼓室, 中耳
lemmas.def_en: the main cavity of the ear; between the eardrum and the inner ear

examples.en: The doctor examined her damaged tympanum to explain the sudden loss of hearing.
examples.zh: 医生检查了她受损的耳膜，以解释这突如其来的听力下降。

lemmas.def_en: a large hemispherical brass or copper percussion instrument with a drumhead that can be tuned by adjusting the tension on it

examples.en: The sudden rumble of the tympani created immense dramatic tension during the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会上定音鼓的突然轰鸣营造了极大的戏剧性紧张感。

lemmas.def_en: a person who plays the kettledrums

lemmas.def_zh: 鼓似的, 鼓膜的, 鼓室的
lemmas.def_en: resembling a drum

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tympani 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the forelimb of a quadruped

examples.en: The injured dog held up its right foreleg to avoid putting weight on it.
examples.zh: 受伤的狗抬起右前腿，避免用力踩在地上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreleg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any tropical African shrub of the genus Protea having alternate rigid leaves and dense colorful flower heads resembling cones

examples.en: The bride carried a striking floral bouquet dominated by a large pink king protea.
examples.zh: 新娘手捧一束引人注目的鲜花，其中以一朵巨大的粉色帝王花为主。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the nest of a squirrel

examples.en: High up in the oak tree, we spotted a squirrel curled inside its cozy drey.
examples.zh: 在高高的橡树上，我们发现一只松鼠蜷缩在它舒适的窝巢里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 drey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能看到远处的, 有先见之明的, 远视的
lemmas.def_en: able to see distant objects clearly

examples.en: Thanks to farsighted urban planning, the coastal city survived the storm with minimal damage.
examples.zh: 多亏了富有远见的城市规划，这座沿海城市在风暴中仅遭受微小损失。

lemmas.def_en: a reduced ability to focus on near objects caused by loss of elasticity of the crystalline lens after age 45

family_guide.root_logic: 以 farsighted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 基质, 底质, 底座
lemmas.def_en: a mass of fungal tissue that has spore-bearing structures embedded in it or on it

examples.en: In plant biology, the dark reactions of photosynthesis take place within the chloroplast stroma.
examples.zh: 在植物生物学中，光合作用的暗反应发生在叶绿体基质中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stroma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small pellet of ice that falls during a hailstorm

examples.en: A massive hailstone shattered the car windshield during the sudden summer thunderstorm yesterday.
examples.zh: 在昨天突如其来的夏季雷暴中，一块巨大的冰雹砸碎了汽车挡风玻璃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hailstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: full and loud and deep

examples.en: The grandfather clock produced a sonorous chime that echoed clearly through the quiet house.
examples.zh: 老式落地钟发出一声洪亮的鸣响，在安静的房子里清晰回荡。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆润低沉地; 感人地; 堂皇地; 朗朗地
lemmas.def_en: in a sonorous manner

examples.en: the congregation consisted chiefly of a few young folk, who snored sonorously

lemmas.def_en: having the character of a loud deep sound; the quality of being resonant

examples.en: The remarkable sonority of her operatic voice filled the entire concert hall effortlessly.
examples.zh: 她歌剧嗓音中非凡的浑厚响亮感轻而易举地充盈了整个音乐厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sonorous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who exercises power by virtue of wealth

examples.en: The wealthy plutocrat purchased another luxury yacht without even considering the exorbitant maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 那位大财阀买下了另一艘豪华游艇，甚至都没考虑昂贵的维护费用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plutocrat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the noise of something spattering or sputtering explosively

examples.en: With an angry splutter, the frustrated mechanic tried repeatedly to restart the smoking engine.
examples.zh: 在一阵急促慌乱的嘟囔声中，沮丧的修理工反复尝试重新启动冒烟的引擎。

lemmas.def_zh: vt. 急促而慌乱地说；发出吐唾沫声
lemmas.def_en: utter with a spitting sound, as if in a rage

examples.en: With an angry splutter, the frustrated mechanic tried repeatedly to restart the smoking engine.
examples.zh: 在一阵急促慌乱的嘟囔声中，沮丧的修理工反复尝试重新启动冒烟的引擎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splutter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: excessive but superficial compliments given with affected charm

examples.en: Her obvious smarm failed to impress the hiring manager, who preferred honest and direct answers.
examples.zh: 她明显的阿谀奉承并未打动招聘经理，经理更喜欢诚实直接的回答。

lemmas.def_zh: 虚情假意的, 爱说奉承话的
lemmas.def_en: unpleasantly and excessively suave or ingratiating in manner or speech

examples.en: buttery praise
gave him a fulsome introduction

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smarm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an informal conversation

examples.en: Ambitious young executives gathered near the bar to schmooze with influential industry leaders tonight.
examples.zh: 雄心勃勃的年轻主管们今晚聚集在酒吧附近，与有影响力的行业领袖闲聊套近乎。

lemmas.def_en: talk idly or casually and in a friendly way

examples.en: Ambitious young executives gathered near the bar to schmooze with influential industry leaders tonight.
examples.zh: 雄心勃勃的年轻主管们今晚聚集在酒吧附近，与有影响力的行业领袖闲聊套近乎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schmooze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a word that expresses a meaning opposed to the meaning of another word, in which case the two words are antonyms of each other

examples.en: The teacher asked the elementary students to identify the correct antonym for the word huge.
examples.zh: 老师要求小学生们找出单词“huge”的正确反义词。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antonym 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: variety of silica containing microcrystalline quartz

examples.en: Prehistoric hunters frequently shaped sharp arrowheads out of locally sourced deposits of dense chert.
examples.zh: 史前猎人经常利用当地致密的燧石矿床打造锋利的箭头。

lemmas.def_en: resembling or containing chert

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chert 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: disarrange or rumple; dishevel

examples.en: A sudden gust of wind swept across the deck and tousled her neat hair.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的大风席卷甲板，吹乱了她整齐的头发。

lemmas.def_en: (of hair) untidy, messy, or disheveled
lemmas.usage_note: 几乎专用于形容人的头发（tousled hair），常带有随意、刚睡醒或受风吹后的意味，不一定含贬义。

examples.en: He walked into the kitchen with tousled hair and sleepy eyes.
examples.zh: 他顶着一头凌乱的头发、睡眼惺忪地走进了厨房。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tousle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 除去, 排除, 使成为不必要, 避免
lemmas.def_en: do away with

examples.en: Regular physical exercise and a balanced diet can obviate the need for expensive medical treatments.
examples.zh: 规律的体育锻炼和均衡的饮食可以免除接受昂贵药物治疗的必要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obviate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嵌花, 贴花, 加缝刺绣
lemmas.def_en: a decorative design made of one material sewn over another

examples.en: The artisan stitched a floral applique onto the front of the handmade cotton quilt.
examples.zh: 工匠在手工棉被的正面缝上了一块花卉贴花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 applique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a photograph of a muscular man in minimal attire

examples.en: The fitness magazine featured a muscular beefcake on its cover to attract new casual readers.
examples.zh: 该健身杂志在封面上刊登了一位肌肉猛男的照片，以吸引普通新读者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beefcake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: broken stone used in macadamized roadways

examples.en: The road workers smoothed fresh macadam across the damaged surface to repair the countryside lane.
examples.zh: 道路工人在受损路面上平铺了新鲜的碎石路料，以修复乡村小径。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 macadam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a crisp smooth lustrous fabric

examples.en: She wore an exquisite green evening gown made of stiff taffeta to the grand gala.
examples.zh: 她身穿一件由挺括的塔夫绸制成的高雅绿色晚礼服参加了盛大晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 taffeta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the aqueous part of the cytoplasm within which various particles and organelles are suspended

examples.en: Many essential metabolic reactions occur directly within the liquid cytosol of the living animal cell.
examples.zh: 许多重要的代谢反应直接在活体动物细胞的液体胞液中发生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cytosol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 黑手党成员, 秘密政党成员
lemmas.def_en: a member of the Sicilian Mafia

examples.en: Federal agents secretly photographed the suspected mafioso entering a private club in the city center.
examples.zh: 联邦特工秘密拍下了疑似黑手党成员进入市中心一家私人俱乐部的画面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mafioso 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 曲线的, 由曲线组成的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by or following a curved line

examples.en: The modern art museum features a striking curvilinear facade that curves gracefully around the plaza.
examples.zh: 这座现代艺术博物馆拥有引人注目的曲线型立面，优雅地环绕着广场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 curvilinear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: complete power over a person or situation

examples.en: Rising raw material prices placed a severe financial chokehold on small family-owned manufacturing businesses.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的原材料价格对小型家族制造业构成了严峻的经济制约。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chokehold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [俚]书呆子, 死用功的学生
lemmas.def_en: an insignificant student who is ridiculed as being affected or boringly studious

examples.en: The brilliant policy wonk spent hours analyzing complex statistical charts before advising the senator.
examples.zh: 那位聪颖的政策专家在向参议员进言前，花了数小时分析复杂的统计图表。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wonk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: light informal conversation for social occasions

examples.en: We engaged in polite chitchat while waiting for the elevator doors to open on our floor.
examples.zh: 在等待电梯门在我们楼层打开时，我们进行了礼貌的闲聊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chitchat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a government building housing the office of a chancellor

examples.en: Protesters gathered peacefully outside the historic chancellery to voice opposition to the newly proposed law.
examples.zh: 抗议者和平聚集在历史悠久的总理府外，对新提议的法案表示反对。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chancellery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (usually plural) loose-fitting nightclothes worn for sleeping or lounging; have a jacket top and trousers

examples.en: The little boy brushed his teeth and changed into his cozy jammies.
examples.zh: 小男孩刷了牙，换上了舒适的睡衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jammies 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: close sociological study of a maladjusted person or family for diagnosis and treatment

examples.en: Her daily casework involves helping low-income families find stable housing.
examples.zh: 她的日常社会工作包括帮助低收入家庭找到稳定的住房。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 casework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shrub of the genus Carissa having fragrant white flowers and plumlike red to purple-black fruits

examples.en: Carissa finished her presentation early and took questions from the audience.
examples.zh: 卡丽莎提前结束了演讲，并回答了观众的提问。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carissa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sword with a broad blade and (usually) two cutting edges; used to cut rather than stab

examples.en: The ancient warrior unsheathed his heavy broadsword with a single swift motion.
examples.zh: 古代战士动作迅捷地拔出了他沉重的阔剑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 broadsword 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 防风林, 防风茄克衫, 风衣
lemmas.def_en: a kind of heavy jacket (`windcheater' is a British term)

examples.en: You should wear a windbreaker today because the autumn breeze is quite chilly.
examples.zh: 你今天应该穿件风衣，因为秋风挺冷的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 windbreaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 污物, 粘性物质, 畸形人, 亚洲佬(对韩、日等国人的轻蔑称呼)
lemmas.def_en: any thick, viscous matter

examples.en: She used a damp cloth to wipe the sticky gook off the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 她用湿布擦掉了厨房操作台上黏糊糊的污垢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of a blood vessel

examples.en: The doctor ran several blood tests to determine if the inflammation was vasculitis.
examples.zh: 医生做了几次血液检查，以确定该炎症是否为血管炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vasculitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: knowledge of an event before it occurs

examples.en: They invested in the market without any foreknowledge of the coming economic crisis.
examples.zh: 他们在对即将到来的经济危机毫无预知的情况下投资了该市场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foreknowledge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 过境道路, 直达道路
lemmas.def_en: a broad highway designed for high-speed traffic

examples.en: We took the high-speed thruway to avoid heavy downtown traffic during rush hour.
examples.zh: 我们走高速直达路，以避开高峰期市中心的拥堵交通。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thruway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a racehorse that runs well on a muddy racetrack

examples.en: Because it rained all morning, the race favorite was a seasoned mudder.
examples.zh: 因为下了一整早的雨，夺冠热门成了一匹经验丰富的泥地马。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mudder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 德麦拉拉蔗糖(红糖的一种)
lemmas.def_en: a light brown raw cane sugar from Guyana

examples.en: She sprinkled a spoonful of raw Demerara sugar over her morning oatmeal.
examples.zh: 她在早晨的燕麦粥上撒了一勺未经精炼的德麦拉拉蔗糖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demerara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to spatial distribution

examples.en: The research team analyzed the distributional patterns of rare bird species across the continent.
examples.zh: 研究团队分析了珍稀鸟类在整个大陆的分布格局。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 distributional 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a meter to compare strengths of magnetic fields

examples.en: Scientists used a sensitive magnetometer to detect subtle changes in the local magnetic field.
examples.zh: 科学家使用高灵敏度磁强计探测局部磁场的细微变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 magnetometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the endocardium and heart valves

examples.en: Untreated bacterial infections can sometimes spread to heart valves and cause severe endocarditis.
examples.zh: 未治疗的细菌感染有时会扩散至心脏瓣膜，引起严重的心内膜炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 endocarditis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 指愚笨或不是好人
lemmas.def_en: a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence

examples.en: Some arrogant fuckhead cut in front of me in line without apologizing.
examples.zh: 有个自大的混蛋插了我的队，连句道歉都没有。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fuckhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing

examples.en: The old textile manufactory was recently converted into a trendy modern art museum.
examples.zh: 那家旧纺织厂最近被改造成了一座时尚的现代艺术博物馆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manufactory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being two more than fifty

examples.en: Chapter LII of the historical novel depicts the climactic battle between the armies.
examples.zh: 这部历史小说的第五十二章描绘了两军之间的高潮决战。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大元帅, 大总统, 总司令
lemmas.def_en: the officer who holds the supreme command

examples.en: The newly appointed generalissimo took full command of all the nation's armed forces.
examples.zh: 新任命的统帅全面接管了该国所有武装力量的指挥权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 generalissimo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a percussion instrument with wooden bars tuned to produce a chromatic scale and with resonators; played with small mallets

examples.en: The musician produced warm, resonant tones while striking the wooden bars of the marimba.
examples.zh: 音乐家敲击马林巴木琴的琴键，发出温暖共鸣的音调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marimba 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wholesale packaging of meat for future sale (including slaughtering and processing and distribution to retailers)

examples.en: Many immigrant workers found their first employment opportunities in the city's meatpacking industry.
examples.zh: 许多移民工人在这座城市的肉类加工行业找到了第一份工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meatpacking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 电震, 电休克, 电击疗法
lemmas.def_en: the administration of a strong electric current that passes through the brain to induce convulsions and coma

examples.en: Modern electroshock therapy is administered under general anesthesia to treat severe depression safely.
examples.zh: 现代电休克疗法在全身麻醉下进行，可安全治疗重度抑郁症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electroshock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large black bass; the angle of the jaw falls behind the eye

examples.en: He spent the entire peaceful morning fishing for largemouth bass on the lake.
examples.zh: 他在湖上度过了宁静的一上午，专心钓大口黑鲈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 largemouth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ship equipped to detect and then destroy or neutralize or remove marine mines

examples.en: The naval minesweeper cleared a safe passage through the heavily contested harbor waters.
examples.zh: 这艘海军扫雷舰在冲突激烈的港口水域中清理出一条安全通道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minesweeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 睡椅;抽烟室;州财政长官;首相
lemmas.def_en: a Muslim council of state

examples.en: He rested on the plush diwan while enjoying a quiet afternoon of reading.
examples.zh: 他靠在舒适的睡椅上，享受着安静阅读的下午时光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diwan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平版印刷的, 石版的
lemmas.def_en: of or produced by or involved in lithography

examples.en: The museum displayed a rare collection of nineteenth-century lithographic prints yesterday.
examples.zh: 博物馆昨天展出了一批珍贵的19世纪平版印刷画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lithographic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reproduction by parents of different races (especially by white and non-white persons)

examples.en: Historic laws banning miscegenation were eventually ruled unconstitutional by the supreme court.
examples.zh: 历史上禁止跨种族通婚的法律最终被最高法院裁定为违宪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 miscegenation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large inoffensive chiefly nocturnal ungulate of tropical America and southeast Asia having a heavy body and fleshy snout

examples.en: A solitary tapir emerged from the dense rainforest to drink at the riverbank.
examples.zh: 一只独行的貘从茂密的热带雨林中走出来，到河边饮水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tapir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a male slave

examples.en: The escaped bondsman risked everything to secure freedom for his young family.
examples.zh: 逃跑的奴隶冒着失去一切的危险为他年轻的家人争取自由。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bondsman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同义, 同义字重复, 同义字研究
lemmas.def_en: the semantic relation that holds between two words that can (in a given context) express the same meaning

examples.en: The linguistic paper explores the rich synonymy between related legal terms in English.
examples.zh: 这篇语言学论文探讨了英语中相关法律术语之间丰富的同义现象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synonymy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 诗体学, 韵律学, 作诗法
lemmas.def_en: the patterns of stress and intonation in a language

examples.en: Mastering English prosody helps non-native speakers achieve a much more natural rhythm.
examples.zh: 掌握英语韵律有助于非母语者展现更自然的语音节奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prosody 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: delicacy that is highly dangerous because of a potent nerve poison in ovaries and liver

examples.en: Only licensed chefs are legally permitted to prepare blowfish due to its deadly toxin.
examples.zh: 由于河豚含有致命毒素，法律规定只有持证厨师才能料理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blowfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: showing characteristics of age, especially having grey or white hair; -Coleridge

examples.en: He entertained the guests with a hoary joke that everyone had heard before.
examples.zh: 他讲了一个大家都听过的老掉牙笑话来逗乐客人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未必会地, 不象真实地
lemmas.def_en: not easy to believe

examples.en: Against all odds, the underdog team improbably won the national championship this season.
examples.zh: 克服了一切不利条件，这支不被看好的队伍本赛季不可思议地赢得了全国冠军。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 improbably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有营养的, 滋养的, 与营养有关的
lemmas.def_en: of or providing nourishment

examples.en: Whole grains offer exceptional nutritive value compared to highly refined breakfast cereals.
examples.zh: 与高度精制的早餐谷物相比，全谷物提供了极高的营养价值。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nutritive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extinct flying reptile

examples.en: The museum unveiled a life-sized model of a pterodactyl hanging from the ceiling.
examples.zh: 博物馆揭幕了一个悬挂在天花板上的等身大小翼手龙模型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pterodactyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 解朊的, 水解蛋白质的, 蛋白水解作用的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to proteolysis

examples.en: Pineapple contains a strong proteolytic enzyme that can break down tough meat fibers quickly.
examples.zh: 菠萝含有一种强效的蛋白水解酶，能迅速分解坚韧的肉类纤维。

lemmas.def_zh: 解朊作用, 蛋白水解作用
lemmas.def_en: the hydrolysis of proteins into peptides and amino acids by cleavage of their peptide bonds

examples.en: Digestive enzymes initiate proteolysis by breaking down large dietary proteins in the stomach.
examples.zh: 消化酶通过在胃中分解大分子膳食蛋白质来启动蛋白水解作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 proteolytic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舷外支架, 突出的梁,桁等
lemmas.def_en: a stabilizer for a canoe; spars attach to a shaped log or float parallel to the hull

examples.en: The fishermen stabilized their traditional wooden canoe by attaching a sturdy bamboo outrigger.
examples.zh: 渔民们通过安装坚固的竹制舷外支架来稳定他们传统的独木舟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outrigger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轮转焰火, 纸风车, 快速旋转的东西
lemmas.def_en: perennial subshrub of Tenerife having leaves in rosettes resembling pinwheels

examples.en: The little girl happily ran across the park, watching her colorful pinwheel spin.
examples.zh: 小女孩开心地穿过公园，看着她五彩斑斓的纸风车飞转。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinwheel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 演员的, 演剧的, 矫揉造作的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of acting or a stage performance; often affected

examples.en: Nobody took his histrionic complaints seriously because he always exaggerated minor problems.
examples.zh: 没人把他的大呼小叫当回事，因为他总是夸大微不足道的问题。

lemmas.def_zh: 戏剧表演, 舞台艺术, 演员, (贬)装模作样
lemmas.def_en: a performance of a play

examples.en: Ignore his dramatic histrionics; he always exaggerates small setbacks to gain extra sympathy.
examples.zh: 别理会他演戏般的装模作样，他总是夸大微小的挫折来博取同情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 histrionic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: periapsis in Earth orbit; the point in its orbit where a satellite is nearest to the Earth

examples.en: During its perigee, the moon appears significantly larger and brighter in the night sky.
examples.zh: 在近地点期间，月亮在夜空中显得明显更大、更亮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perigee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: offensively malodorous

examples.en: A fetid odor rose from the stagnant pool after weeks of intense summer heat.
examples.zh: 经过数周的酷暑，死水池塘里散发出一股恶臭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fetid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a horse of light tan or golden color with cream-colored or white mane and tail

examples.en: She proudly rode her golden palomino along the sunlit coastal trail this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，她骄傲地骑着她那匹金色的帕洛米诺马走在洒满阳光的沿海小道上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palomino 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who lends money at interest in exchange for personal property that is deposited as security

examples.en: He reluctantly visited the local pawnbroker to trade his vintage watch for fast cash.
examples.zh: 他迫不得已去找当地的当铺老板，把老式手表换成了应急现金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pawnbroker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lack of gratitude

examples.en: She was deeply hurt by the sheer ingratitude of the relatives she had sheltered.
examples.zh: 她曾庇护过的亲戚竟如此忘恩负义，这深深地伤害了她。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ingratitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the 26th letter of the Roman alphabet

examples.en: The old alphabet rhyme ended with izzard rather than the modern letter name zed.
examples.zh: 那首古老的字母童谣以 izzard 结尾，而不是现代的字母读音 zed。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 izzard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分子, 计算者, 计算的东西

examples.zh: 要计算这些分数相加，必须在将分子相加前找到公分母。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 numerator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: terrorism using the weapons of biological warfare

examples.en: The government conducted drills to prepare emergency services for potential threats of bioterrorism.
examples.zh: 政府举行了演习，以使应急部门做好应对潜在生物恐怖主义威胁的准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bioterrorism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a North American vine with fragrant blossoms and edible tubers; important food crop of Native Americans

examples.zh: 该地区的农民很大程度上依赖落花生收成来获取收入。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groundnut 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tiny or scarcely detectable amount

examples.en: Could you add just a smidgen of salt to bring out the flavor?
examples.zh: 你能少加一点点盐来提味吗？

family_guide.root_logic: 以 smidgen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infections of the skin or nails caused by fungi and appearing as itching circular patches

examples.en: The veterinarian diagnosed the stray kitten with ringworm and prescribed a topical antifungal cream.
examples.zh: 兽医诊断这只流浪小猫患有癣菌病，并开了一种外用抗真菌药膏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ringworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a painted or carved screen placed above and behind an altar or communion table

examples.en: Tourists gathered in the ancient cathedral to admire the magnificent carved wooden altarpiece.
examples.zh: 游客们聚集在古老的大教堂里，欣赏那座宏伟的木雕祭坛画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 altarpiece 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a communal dining-hall (usually in a monastery)

examples.en: The monks gathered silently in the refectory for their simple evening meal.
examples.zh: 僧侣们静静地聚集在餐厅里吃简单的晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refectory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: linguistics defined as the analysis of formal structures in a text or discourse

examples.zh: 他的文学分析在很大程度上依赖于法国结构主义的核心原则。

lemmas.def_zh: 假装, 做作, 矫情

examples.zh: 她那夸张的英国口音只是在暑期班里学来的一种做作姿态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 affectation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 新奇的, 最新式的, 最新流行的
lemmas.def_en: (of a new kind or fashion) gratuitously new

examples.zh: 与这些最新奇的便携式小玩意相比，我祖父更喜欢他的机械打字机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newfangled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of a cell or organism having a single set of chromosomes

examples.en: During meiosis, the diploid cell divides to produce four distinct haploid gametes.

lemmas.def_en: listen; used mostly in the imperative

examples.zh: 老水手警告旅行者要留心倾听逼近的风暴声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hearken 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 黑种草属；大马士革黑种草；黑种草花
lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Nigella

examples.zh: 面包师在刚揉好的大饼生面团上撒上了芳香的黑种草籽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nigella 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 阳光照射不到的, 阴暗的

examples.zh: 这个北部山谷的冬季特点是长达数月寒冷而阴暗无光的日子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sunless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 芬芳的, 有...香味的, 令人想起...的

examples.zh: 温暖的厨房里弥漫着令人垂涎的新烤面包和肉桂香味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 redolent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 具结, 保证书, 保证金, 保释金

examples.zh: 法官同意以该年轻罪犯自身具结的方式将其释放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recognizance 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 这位著名的爵士女歌手以其深沉如丝绒般的歌喉迷住了全场观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 songstress 为核心的派生词族。

examples.zh: 供应小肠的血管穿行于肠系膜的褶皱之中。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or located in a mesentery

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mesentery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the science of analyzing and deciphering codes and ciphers and cryptograms

examples.en: She pursued a degree in cryptology to help decipher historical espionage codes.
examples.zh: 她攻读密码术学位，以协助破译历史上的间谍密码。
